chapters.title: Chapter 382: Luke Finally Uses His Strongest Current Titan Form!
paragraphs: "Huff... Huff..."
Luke remained on one knee, drawing rough breaths as the lingering pain gradually receded from his mind.
His thoughts were finally becoming clearer, although the bloodshot appearance of his eyes showed just how badly the chains had affected him.
’That was too close.’
He raised his head toward Kiki, which was still pulling the eight commanders through its crimson restraints, and felt a trace of relief.
Unfortunately, before he could properly recover, Brukha’s furious shout echoed from the other side of the clearing.
"ALL OF YOU, ATTACK!"
OHHHHMMMMM!
A tremendous influx of energy suddenly swept across the battlefield.
Luke immediately looked up, only to discover that the millions of Orcs surrounding the outpost had begun activating their ancestral techniques.
Crimson tattoos flared across their bodies, and the surrounding air became filled with strange red radiance as groups of lower-ranked warriors gathered together.
Then their bodies began forming gigantic ancestral phantoms.
The F-Rank Orcs combined first, their individual bodies becoming parts of the manifested warriors, forming limbs, torsos, and other sections through the power of the formation.
D-Rank and C-Rank warriors followed, creating their own larger and denser manifestations.
VMMMMM! RRRRRUMBLE!
The surrounding ground shook as one Orc phantom after another rose above the forest, their bodies reaching hundreds of feet in height while crimson energy flowed between the warriors sustaining them.
Within a short time, the millions of individual Orcs had been reorganized into several thousand gigantic phantoms, each radiating power comparable to B-Rank.
Their sheer height caused nearby trees to bend beneath the pressure of their movements, while sections of the surrounding ground fractured as the phantoms settled into formation.
Luke stared at the transformation, his expression gradually becoming more annoyed than frightened.
’Seriously?’
He had barely recovered from having his mind assaulted by those damned chains, and now the Orcs were bringing out yet another ridiculous technique.
’These guys really don’t know when to stop.’
However, beneath his irritation, Luke understood how dangerous the situation had become.

The ancestral phantoms had turned an army of lower-ranked warriors into a force capable of participating in a much higher-level battle, demonstrating the advantage possessed by an ancient race with a powerful inheritance.
He glanced toward Kiki, where the eight Peak B-Rank commanders were still being restrained.
Unfortunately, the crimson light covering Kiki’s chains was already beginning to weaken.
’Those chains aren’t being supplied by the formation like the ones that captured me.’
Every second that passed made the restraints slightly less stable, and Luke knew the eight commanders would eventually free themselves.
’I need to hurry.’
He turned toward the crimson dome covering the sky, trying to think of a way to escape before the full force of the Orc army reached him.
However, another wave of hostile shouts soon interrupted his thoughts.
"KILL HIM!"
"I’LL TAKE THE HERO’S HEAD!"
OHHHHMMMM!
The hundred B-Rank Orcs also activated their ancestral phantoms, each manifestation rising between fifty and one hundred and fifty feet tall.
Unlike the phantoms formed by the lower-ranked warriors, these were noticeably denser, their bodies carrying powerful auras as crimson energy flowed across their surfaces.
Soon, a hundred ancestral warriors stood before Luke, their enormous fists tightening while the surrounding army roared in anticipation.
Luke stared at them for a brief moment before finally making his decision.
’Yeah, I really need to hurry.’
He exhaled slowly, then called upon the strongest form currently available to him.
’Azrion... Nyx... Fusion!’
RUMMMMMBLE!
The moment that thought formed, the space surrounding Luke began rippling, followed by a violent pressure that spread outward from his body.
KRRRRAAAACK!
The ground beneath his feet fractured as his fifty-foot Thunder Titan physique began changing, its black, armored skin giving way to a different physical structure.
His muscles expanded, his skeletal frame lengthened, and the proportions of his body gradually shifted into a more refined and powerful build.
The transformation continued until a seventy-foot-tall Titan stood where Voltrax had been only moments earlier.
Vorthar.
The fusion of Azrion, the Atlas Titan, and Nyx, the Void Titan.

His transformed body possessed the physical foundation of an Atlas Titan, combined with the characteristics of the Void, while the surrounding space continued trembling beneath the pressure released during his transformation.
Then a golden-white radiance gathered behind his head.
OHHMMMM!
A circular halo formed from condensed Cosmic Energy slowly materialized, its luminous surface rotating as dense energy pulsed through the surrounding air.
The sudden transformation caused several charging Orc phantoms to hesitate, with some stopping long enough to examine the unfamiliar Titan standing before them.
"He’s transformed again!"
"What kind of Giant is that?!"
Unfortunately, Luke paid them no attention.
His gaze remained fixed upon the crimson dome overhead.
’First, I need to destroy that thing.’
"ATTACK!"
The hundred B-Rank Orcs finally abandoned their hesitation and charged toward him, their ancestral phantoms crossing the ruined clearing with terrifying momentum.
THUD! THUD! THUD!
The ground shook beneath their movements, while the pressure from their combined auras caused loose debris to scatter across the battlefield.
All hundred phantoms converged upon Luke’s position from the northern side, raising their enormous fists as they prepared to crush him beneath a coordinated attack.
KRRRUMBLE!
However, just as the leading phantoms were closing in, the space on either side of Luke suddenly distorted.
VMMMM!
Two circular spatial ripples appeared beside his body.
From those distortions emerged two identical seventy-foot-tall Vorthar Titans, each possessing the same physique as Luke’s main body.
However, their halos were different.
The clone standing to his left possessed a rotating rainbow-colored halo, while the one standing to his right had a pitch-black halo radiating dense Void Energy.
Luke immediately divided his concentration among the three bodies, assigning twenty-five percent of his focus to each clone while retaining the remaining fifty percent for himself.
The sudden appearance of two additional Titans shocked the approaching commanders.
"CLONES?!"
"THERE ARE THREE OF HIM!"
However, this time, the Orcs didn’t abandon their attack.
"KEEP GOING! CRUSH THEM TOGETHER!"
With furious shouts, the hundred B-Rank phantoms continued their charge, bringing their fists forward in a coordinated barrage aimed directly at Luke.
BOOOOM! WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
The first wave of punches displaced the surrounding air, generating violent shockwaves even before reaching their target.
At that exact moment, the Vorthar clone possessing the black halo stepped forward.
He raised his right arm, spreading his fingers as though preparing to stop the entire attack with a single open palm.
Then he closed his eyes.
’Focus the Void ahead of me, not throughout my body.’
Luke repeated that thought through the clone, directing his concentration toward the space immediately in front of his extended hand.
The black halo suddenly flared.
VMMMMMMMM!
Darkness spread outward from its surface, distorting the air until the space before the clone appeared strangely stretched.
Meanwhile, the hundred fists were already descending.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Just before the first blow reached his body, the clone opened his eyes.
"Void Horizon."
OHHHHMMMM!
An almost invisible layer of Void Energy condensed directly in front of his palm, forming a spatial boundary between himself and the incoming attacks.
Then the hundred punches landed.
FWHOOOSH! FWHOOOSH! FWHOOOSH!
The impact released a series of violent air shockwaves, causing dust and loose debris to roll across the clearing.
However, the enormous fists stopped before reaching the clone.
Their movements appeared to slow almost completely, as though the remaining distance between them and the Titan had suddenly become impossible to cross.
"What?!"
Several Orc Captains stared in disbelief as their ancestral phantoms continued exerting force, yet none of their attacks managed to advance any farther.
From their perspective, a single D-Rank Hero had just stopped the combined punches of a hundred B-Rank warriors without even allowing the blows to touch his body.
However, the strange phenomenon wasn’t caused by ordinary defense.
Void Horizon had stretched the space between the attacks and Luke’s clone, forcing the fists to travel through a distance far greater than what appeared to exist before them.
While the hundred phantoms remained occupied with that invisible barrier, the second Vorthar clone stepped forward.
The rainbow-colored halo behind his head began rotating faster, its four distinct colors growing brighter as he raised his right hand toward the gathered enemies.
Then four familiar names escaped his mouth.
"Seal of Suppression"
"Seal of Silence"
"Seal of Restraint"
"Seal of Closure"
The rainbow halo immediately erupted with brilliant radiance, its four colored sections flaring as the power of Sevaroth’s Sealing Authority spread across the battlefield.
VMMMMMMMM!
Hundreds of dark-blue rings emerged from the halo, followed by countless white-gold threads, radiant golden shackles, and dark crimson eye-shaped sigils.

Each manifestation carried a different sealing effect, and as Luke’s clone extended his hand, they scattered toward the hundred B-Rank Orcs whose ancestral phantoms were still struggling against Void Horizon.
FWHIP! FWHIP! FWHIP!
The dark-blue rings reached their targets first, rapidly rotating around the Orcs’ bodies before tightening into place.

At the same time, white-gold threads wrapped around their casting points, golden shackles materialized around their wrists and ankles, and dark crimson eye-shaped sigils appeared directly over the glowing ancestral tattoos.
OHHMMMM!
"UGH! WHAT IS THIS?!"
"MY STRENGTH IS DISAPPEARING!"
The Orcs immediately began struggling, but the restraints continued tightening as their auras weakened and their movements became increasingly restricted.
Several warriors attempted to activate their bloodline powers, only to discover that the crimson tattoos responsible for sustaining their ancestral phantoms had begun losing their radiance.
"What?! MY PHANTOM!"

chapters.title: Chapter 383: Luke’s Clone Is Suppressing 100 B-Ranks Alone?!
paragraphs: One of the enormous ancestral warriors suddenly trembled, its previously solid body becoming transparent as the energy maintaining its form weakened.
Then another followed.
VMMMM! FWOOSH!

Across the northern side of the clearing, the hundred ancestral phantoms began flickering, their crimson bodies gradually collapsing as the seals interfered with the connections between the Orcs and their bloodline techniques.
Within moments, several manifestations disappeared completely, leaving their original B-Rank warriors exposed beneath the strange restraints.
"HOW IS THIS POSSIBLE?!"
The sudden development shocked the surrounding Orc army, since their ancestral manifestations weren’t ordinary spells that could easily be interrupted by conventional magic.

Their power originated from the bloodline techniques preserved by the Zhurkhal Tribe, and the crimson tattoos covering their bodies served as the medium through which those ancestral powers were manifested.
However, Sevaroth’s seals were specifically designed to restrict different aspects of a target’s existence, including the powers and connections responsible for maintaining supernatural abilities.
The Seal of Silence, in particular, could interfere with the manifestation of bloodline techniques, while the remaining three seals weakened, restrained, and closed the affected connections.

Consequently, as the ancestral phantoms disappeared, the four sealing effects shifted toward the Orcs’ original bodies, further restricting their movements and preventing them from immediately restoring their powers.
Even the three A-Rank leaders watching from above were startled by this unexpected development.
"HE CAN SUPPRESS OUR ANCESTRAL PHANTOMS?!" Gorzak shouted, unable to believe that the Hero possessed another ability capable of countering their tribe’s inheritance.
Kroghar’s expression also became increasingly serious, while Vradok carefully observed the rainbow-colored halo behind Luke’s clone.
He understood that the young Hero was somehow interfering with the power of their ancestral tattoos, although he couldn’t determine the exact principle behind those strange seals.
Unfortunately for Luke, suppressing a hundred B-Rank Orcs simultaneously was far from easy.
His clone’s Cosmic Heart was continuously pumping energy through its body, supplying the four seals with the power needed to maintain their effects.
Yet even with that support, the consumption was becoming difficult to sustain, especially since several of the targets had reached High B-Rank.
’This won’t last long.’
Luke could sense the pressure through his clone, but he wasn’t particularly concerned.
After all, the two clones had never been intended to defeat the entire Orc army.
Their purpose was to buy him time.
And now, he finally had enough.
Luke’s main body exhaled as he looked upward toward the dark crimson dome.
While his clones continued holding back the hundred B-Rank warriors, he raised his right hand and activated the Cosmic Heart Titan’s power.
OHHHHMMMM!
A brilliant golden-white radiance suddenly spread above him, followed by the appearance of a Cosmic System containing celestial bodies of different sizes.
A blazing sun materialized at its center, surrounded by planets, moons, and asteroids, whose surfaces reflected the concentrated Cosmic Energy circulating throughout the system.
The golden-white halo behind Luke’s head immediately flared, sending additional energy into the manifestation and strengthening its stability without increasing its overall size.
VMMMMMM!
The surrounding air trembled beneath the celestial bodies’ gravitational influence, while the sunlight falling across the clearing shifted as the Cosmic System began moving into position.
Luke ignored the startled shouts coming from the Orcs below and concentrated upon the dome overhead.
He slowly drew his right arm backward, tightening his fist as his seventy-foot Titan body prepared to release an attack.
Then he muttered the name of a technique that had already demonstrated extraordinary destructive power.
"Azrion’s Unwritten Arts"
RUMMMMMBLE!
The ground beneath Luke began trembling as a dense quantity of Force gathered behind him, gradually forming the outline of an enormous Titan.
Within seconds, a spectral manifestation of Azrion appeared behind his body, its height approximately three times greater than Luke’s current seventy-foot form.

Unlike the gigantic manifestation Luke had previously produced inside the artificial trial world, this phantom was considerably smaller, but its appearance still released an intimidating physical pressure across the clearing.
The phantom copied Luke’s movements, drawing its own arm backward as the Force surrounding its body grew increasingly concentrated.
Several nearby Orcs instinctively retreated upon sensing the rising pressure.
"WHAT IS HE PREPARING NOW?!"
"STOP HIM! DON’T LET HIM COMPLETE THAT TECHNIQUE!"
Unfortunately, the hundred B-Rank warriors were still being delayed by Luke’s clones, while the remaining Orc phantoms were too far away to interrupt him immediately.
Luke raised his head and fixed his gaze upon the highest section of the crimson dome.
"First Move: Heaven’s Palm"
OHHHHMMMM!
The moment he activated the technique, the spectral Azrion behind him moved its arm forward, while an extraordinary amount of Force surged upward into the sky.
The gathered energy rapidly expanded, taking the shape of a gigantic spectral palm approximately one kilometer across.
Its five fingers stretched outward as the entire construct continued gathering Force, while the pressure generated by its appearance caused the air beneath it to distort.
The surrounding Orcs stared upward in disbelief.
"A HAND?!"
"HOW CAN THAT THING BE SO BIG?!"
Meanwhile, Luke had already begun arranging the celestial bodies of his Cosmic System along the path leading toward the dome.
The smallest asteroid moved into position at the front, followed by the remaining bodies in increasing order of size, with the blazing sun positioned behind them.
As the alignment stabilized, their combined gravitational influence began gathering along a single trajectory.
Luke tightened his fist.
’Hah... let’s see if this works.’
He drove his right arm forward, sending the gigantic Heaven’s Palm rushing toward the dome.
FWHOOOOOOOSH!
At the same time, the spectral Azrion behind him thrust its arm forward, directing the manifested palm along the trajectory of the Cosmic System.
The enormous construct entered the gravitational alignment, and the concentrated forces immediately began acting upon its extended fingers.
VMMMMMMMM!
Luke attempted to compress the open palm into a fist, just as he had previously done during his battle against the Origin Titan.
However, the current Cosmic System wasn’t powerful enough to reproduce that result.

Despite the gravitational pressure pulling against its fingers, the gigantic palm barely changed shape, and Luke quickly realized that forcing the transformation any further would only waste the limited time his clones had secured.
’Tch! Not enough gravity!’
Nevertheless, the celestial alignment still served another purpose.
The combined gravitational pull continued accelerating Heaven’s Palm, pushing it upward with increasing force as the one-kilometer construct crossed the remaining distance toward the crimson dome.
"HAAAAH!"
Luke poured additional Force into the technique, causing the spectral palm to accelerate even further.
FWHOOOOOOOOOSH!
The enormous hand tore through the air, generating violent turbulence beneath it, while the Orcs standing directly below felt a crushing pressure descend upon their bodies.
Some instinctively raised their arms to protect their heads, while others simply stared upward, unable to comprehend the scale of the attack.
Meanwhile, Emberlyn watched with growing tension from her concealed position.
’Luke...’

She could sense the extraordinary concentration of power gathering around Heaven’s Palm, and although she had already witnessed several of his unusual abilities, she hadn’t expected him to produce such a powerful attack while simultaneously controlling two clones.
The three A-Rank Orcs floating outside the dome also became more attentive, especially Vradok, who could clearly see the gigantic palm approaching their ancestral formation.
Then the attack finally landed.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Heaven’s Palm slammed directly into the upper section of the crimson dome, releasing a tremendous explosion that shook the entire formation.
The point of collision erupted with brilliant energy, while violent shockwaves spread outward beneath the barrier, crushing the air and tearing through the surrounding battlefield.
KRRRRRRRUMBLE!
The ground shook across the region as the force traveled through the atmosphere, causing nearby trees to bend violently before their trunks snapped beneath the pressure.
KRAAAK! KRRRSH! CRASH!
Branches were torn apart, shattered timber scattered through the air, and entire sections of the forest collapsed as the expanding shockwave swept across the surrounding land.
The smaller buildings inside the outpost were ripped apart, their wooden supports breaking while roofing and broken planks flew across the clearing.
Even the distant Orc formations were affected.
"AAAAARGHH!"
"THE SHOCKWAVE!"
"BRACE YOURSELVES!"
Several ancestral phantoms formed by the lower-ranked warriors were struck by the spreading force, causing their enormous bodies to stagger as cracks appeared across their crimson manifestations.
Some attempted to reinforce themselves by drawing additional energy from the dome, but the pressure was too great for the weaker formations to withstand.
BOOM! KRRRRAAAK!
One phantom shattered.
BOOOOM!
Another collapsed shortly afterward, its giant body breaking apart as the Orcs sustaining it were thrown into the destruction.
Across the surrounding battlefield, approximately ten to twenty ancestral phantoms were destroyed by the aftermath, while many others flickered violently as they struggled to maintain their forms.
"AAAHHH!"
The screams of injured and dying Orcs spread throughout the battlefield, although several voices were quickly drowned out by the continuing rumble.
Meanwhile, the crimson dome itself trembled beneath the direct impact.
Waves of energy spread across its curved surface, causing the ancient markings to flare as the formation absorbed and redistributed the force of Heaven’s Palm.
For several seconds, the entire sky appeared to ripple.
Yet despite the intensity of the attack, the dome remained intact.
Below, thick clouds of dust covered the devastated outpost, temporarily obscuring Luke and much of the surrounding army.
However, another strange phenomenon was already occurring within the destruction.
The Orcs who had died from the shockwave, particularly those of D-Rank and above, began undergoing the effects of Luke’s cultivation technique.

Unfortunately, the hundred B-Rank warriors were still being delayed by Luke’s clones, while the remaining Orc phantoms were too far away to interrupt him immediately.
Luke raised his head and fixed his gaze upon the highest section of the crimson dome.
"First Move: Heaven’s Palm"
OHHHHMMMM!
The moment he activated the technique, the spectral Azrion behind him moved its arm forward, while an extraordinary amount of Force surged upward into the sky.
The gathered energy rapidly expanded, taking the shape of a gigantic spectral palm approximately one kilometer across.
Its five fingers stretched outward as the entire construct continued gathering Force, while the pressure generated by its appearance caused the air beneath it to distort.
The surrounding Orcs stared upward in disbelief.
"A HAND?!"
"HOW CAN THAT THING BE SO BIG?!"
Meanwhile, Luke had already begun arranging the celestial bodies of his Cosmic System along the path leading toward the dome.
The smallest asteroid moved into position at the front, followed by the remaining bodies in increasing order of size, with the blazing sun positioned behind them.
As the alignment stabilized, their combined gravitational influence began gathering along a single trajectory.
Luke tightened his fist.
’Hah... let’s see if this works.’
He drove his right arm forward, sending the gigantic Heaven’s Palm rushing toward the dome.
FWHOOOOOOOSH!
At the same time, the spectral Azrion behind him thrust its arm forward, directing the manifested palm along the trajectory of the Cosmic System.
The enormous construct entered the gravitational alignment, and the concentrated forces immediately began acting upon its extended fingers.
VMMMMMMMM!
Luke attempted to compress the open palm into a fist, just as he had previously done during his battle against the Origin Titan.
However, the current Cosmic System wasn’t powerful enough to reproduce that result.

Despite the gravitational pressure pulling against its fingers, the gigantic palm barely changed shape, and Luke quickly realized that forcing the transformation any further would only waste the limited time his clones had secured.
’Tch!
Not enough gravity!’
Nevertheless, the celestial alignment still served another purpose.
The combined gravitational pull continued accelerating Heaven’s Palm, pushing it upward with increasing force as the one-kilometer construct crossed the remaining distance toward the crimson dome.
"HAAAAH!"
Luke poured additional Force into the technique, causing the spectral palm to accelerate even further.
FWHOOOOOOOOOSH!
The enormous hand tore through the air, generating violent turbulence beneath it, while the Orcs standing directly below felt a crushing pressure descend upon their bodies.
Some instinctively raised their arms to protect their heads, while others simply stared upward, unable to comprehend the scale of the attack.
Meanwhile, Emberlyn watched with growing tension from her concealed position.
’Luke...’

She could sense the extraordinary concentration of power gathering around Heaven’s Palm, and although she had already witnessed several of his unusual abilities, she hadn’t expected him to produce such a powerful attack while simultaneously controlling two clones.
The three A-Rank Orcs floating outside the dome also became more attentive, especially Vradok, who could clearly see the gigantic palm approaching their ancestral formation.
Then the attack finally landed.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Heaven’s Palm slammed directly into the upper section of the crimson dome, releasing a tremendous explosion that shook the entire formation.
The point of collision erupted with brilliant energy, while violent shockwaves spread outward beneath the barrier, crushing the air and tearing through the surrounding battlefield.
KRRRRRRRUMBLE!
The ground shook across the region as the force traveled through the atmosphere, causing nearby trees to bend violently before their trunks snapped beneath the pressure.
KRAAAK!
KRRRSH!
CRASH!
Branches were torn apart, shattered timber scattered through the air, and entire sections of the forest collapsed as the expanding shockwave swept across the surrounding land.
The smaller buildings inside the outpost were ripped apart, their wooden supports breaking while roofing and broken planks flew across the clearing.
Even the distant Orc formations were affected.
"AAAAARGHH!"
"THE SHOCKWAVE!"
"BRACE YOURSELVES!"
Several ancestral phantoms formed by the lower-ranked warriors were struck by the spreading force, causing their enormous bodies to stagger as cracks appeared across their crimson manifestations.
Some attempted to reinforce themselves by drawing additional energy from the dome, but the pressure was too great for the weaker formations to withstand.
BOOM!
KRRRRAAAK!
One phantom shattered.
BOOOOM!
Another collapsed shortly afterward, its giant body breaking apart as the Orcs sustaining it were thrown into the destruction.
Across the surrounding battlefield, approximately ten to twenty ancestral phantoms were destroyed by the aftermath, while many others flickered violently as they struggled to maintain their forms.
"AAAHHH!"
The screams of injured and dying Orcs spread throughout the battlefield, although several voices were quickly drowned out by the continuing rumble.
Meanwhile, the crimson dome itself trembled beneath the direct impact.
Waves of energy spread across its curved surface, causing the ancient markings to flare as the formation absorbed and redistributed the force of Heaven’s Palm.
For several seconds, the entire sky appeared to ripple.
Yet despite the intensity of the attack, the dome remained intact.
Below, thick clouds of dust covered the devastated outpost, temporarily obscuring Luke and much of the surrounding army.
However, another strange phenomenon was already occurring within the destruction.
The Orcs who had died from the shockwave, particularly those of D-Rank and above, began undergoing the effects of Luke’s cultivation technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 384: The Orcs Trapped Luke With Millions of Cultivation Resources?!
paragraphs: Their remains were gathered by the strange power, compressed into small crimson pills, and drawn through the dusty battlefield toward Luke’s main body.
FWHOOOSH!
One after another, the Blood Essence Pills disappeared into his Titan form, adding to the energy he had accumulated throughout his earlier raids.
Unfortunately, Luke was far more concerned about the formation overhead.
As the dust gradually settled, he raised his head toward the sky.
The crimson dome was still there.
Its surface had regained its previous stability, and the ancient markings continued rotating as though the terrifying impact had accomplished almost nothing.
Luke’s expression became ugly.
’Tch! It didn’t break!’
Meanwhile, the surviving Orcs began emerging from the dust, several of them looking upward with visible relief.
"THE FORMATION HELD!"
"HE COULDN’T BREAK IT!"
Their excited shouts quickly spread, although the warriors closest to Luke remained unusually cautious.
After witnessing an attack capable of destroying part of their army through its aftermath alone, many had lost the confidence they displayed earlier.
Several even retreated when Luke lowered his gaze toward them.
However, the reactions of the three A-Rank leaders outside the dome were considerably different.
"IS THAT REALLY SOMETHING A D-RANK BODY CAN CONTAIN?!" Gorzak exclaimed, staring at the devastated region beneath the barrier.
The earlier attack had reached a level comparable to Peak B-Rank, something that seemed completely absurd for a Hero whose true cultivation was still D-Rank.
Even the talented warriors belonging to the royal Orc tribes rarely displayed such ridiculous combat ability while remaining so far below their opponents.
Gorzak slowly turned toward Kroghar.
"Are all the puppets of those gods this strong?"
Unfortunately, Kroghar didn’t answer, since he was also examining Luke with a troubled expression.
Vradok, meanwhile, felt increasingly relieved that he had prepared the ancestral dome, although the Hero’s repeated displays were beginning to irritate even him.
’First those strange transformations, then the coffin, the clones, and now this attack...’
He looked toward Luke’s seventy-foot Titan body.
"We never received any reports about this particular transformation."
That wasn’t especially surprising, considering the Hero’s previous opponents had generally been weaker than the commanders currently gathered here.
Most of them had never possessed enough strength to force Luke into revealing his strongest abilities.
However, the Great Shaman was beginning to wonder how many more unexpected techniques the young Hero might possess.
Down below, Luke continued staring at the intact dome for another moment before finally shifting his attention toward the surrounding Orc army.
’All right, that didn’t work.’
He wasn’t particularly interested in repeatedly wasting his energy against a formation capable of withstanding Heaven’s Palm.
However, the destruction caused by his previous attack had revealed something useful.
Several Orcs had died from the shockwave, and the Blood Essence they provided had already increased his cultivation progress.
’So... why don’t I farm them first?’
A smile gradually appeared on his face as he looked toward the thousands of ancestral phantoms surrounding the outpost.
After all, the lower-ranked warriors had gathered themselves into gigantic bodies, making them considerably easier to target than millions of individuals scattered across the forest.
’Perfect. I’ll reduce their numbers before dealing with anything else.’
With that thought, Luke slowly floated upward, rising above the devastated clearing while the golden-white halo behind his head continued supplying Cosmic Energy.
His two clones remained occupied with the hundred B-Rank warriors, leaving his main body free to focus on the lower-ranked army.
Several Orcs noticed him rising into the air and immediately became uneasy.
"WHAT IS HE DOING NOW?!"
"EVERYONE, WATCH HIS HANDS!"
Luke ignored their shouts and looked toward a densely packed section of the battlefield.
Then he raised his right arm.
"Heaven’s Palm!"
OHHHHMMMM!
This time, he didn’t summon the spectral Azrion behind him.
Instead, Force gathered directly above the targeted region, rapidly condensing into another gigantic hand approximately one kilometer across.
The enormous palm appeared over the clustered ancestral phantoms, its five fingers spreading as the pressure beneath it increased.
The nearby Orcs immediately recognized the technique.
"IT’S THAT HAND AGAIN!"
"RUN! GET AWAY FROM THERE!"
The warriors sustaining the phantoms attempted to retreat, but their enormous bodies were packed too closely together, making it difficult to escape the descending attack.

Moreover, the B-Rank strength provided by their formation wasn’t equivalent to the genuine power of a naturally cultivated B-Rank existence, especially when it came to resisting an attack that had already demonstrated Peak B-Rank destructive force.
Luke looked down upon the scrambling Orcs.
’Hah!’
He brought his hand downward.
FWHOOOOOOOOOSH!
The gigantic palm descended, its pressure crushing the air beneath it and causing the ground to sink even before the manifestation reached the targets.
Several Orc phantoms raised their arms in a desperate attempt to resist.
"STOP IT!"
"EVERYONE, POUR MORE ENERGY INTO THE FORMATION!"
Unfortunately, their hurried resistance accomplished very little.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Heaven’s Palm crashed into the densely packed phantoms, releasing a devastating explosion that immediately swallowed a large section of the battlefield.
KRRRRAAAACK!
The earth fractured beneath the impact, and deep trenches spread outward as the force tore through the ground, throwing broken stones and enormous quantities of soil into the air.
Several ancestral phantoms attempted to withstand the attack, their crimson bodies trembling as the pressure pressed down upon them.
However, within fractions of a second, their manifestations shattered.
BOOM! BOOM! KRRRRAAAK!
One after another, the gigantic Orc bodies collapsed beneath the palm, dragging the warriors sustaining them into the destructive impact.
The surrounding terrain was torn apart, leaving deep depressions and fractured trenches where the phantoms had previously stood.
By the time the destructive force finally subsided, an entire section of the Orc army had disappeared.
The surviving warriors stared toward the ruined battlefield, several of them unable to comprehend how so many of their kin had been destroyed in a single attack.
Unfortunately, the horror wasn’t over.
FWHOOOSH!
Within the devastated region, a strange crimson radiance suddenly appeared.
Blood and fragments of flesh belonging to the fallen Orcs began emerging from the surrounding space, gathering together as the power of Luke’s cultivation technique reconstructed their remains.
For a brief instant, thousands of bloodied figures appeared amid the destruction.
Then their screams erupted.
"AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!"

The horrifying cries spread throughout the dome, causing nearby Orcs to recoil in terror as they watched their fallen companions seemingly return from death, only to suffer another terrible moment before being converted into cultivation resources.
"What kind of demonic technique is that?!"
"HE’S DEVOURING THEM!"
Several warriors instinctively retreated, their expression turning into horror as the crimson figures compressed into small Blood Essence Pills.
FWHOOOSH!
The pills immediately gathered into streams of red light and flew toward Luke, disappearing into his body one after another.
Meanwhile, the System displayed his steadily increasing cultivation progress in the corner of his vision.
Luke’s eyes brightened upon seeing the numbers.
’Finally!’
After spending so much time destroying smaller outposts with disappointing results, he was genuinely pleased to see his progress increasing at such a satisfying rate.
He lowered his gaze toward the remaining Orc army, a happy smile gradually appearing on his face.
Unfortunately for the Orcs, that smile only made the situation more frightening.
"H-He is smiling..."
"Why is he looking at us like that?!"
Several warriors began backing away, clearly unwilling to become the next targets of Heaven’s Palm.
Even Emberlyn, who had been anxiously observing the battle, finally felt a trace of relief.
Although Luke was still trapped inside the ancestral dome, the sudden reversal had shown that he possessed enough strength to resist the assembled army, at least for the moment.
’Good...’
She exhaled softly, hoping he would find an opportunity to escape before the A-Rank leaders decided to intervene.
However, in their relief, both Luke and Emberlyn had temporarily overlooked something important.
The eight Peak B-Rank commanders.
"AAAAARGHH! HOW DARE YOU!"
An enraged roar suddenly erupted from the southern side of the clearing.
Luke immediately turned his head.
There, the crimson tattoos covering the eight commanders had begun blazing with renewed intensity, while the weakened chains restraining their wrists trembled beneath their combined resistance.
KRRRRKKK!
Kiki attempted to tighten the bindings, driving its numerous legs deeper into the fractured ground as the commanders exerted their full strength.
"KIKIIII!"
Unfortunately, the restraints had already lost too much energy.
KRRRRAAAAK!
The first pair of chains shattered.
SNAP! CLANK!
Another pair broke, followed almost immediately by the remaining bindings as the eight commanders finally freed themselves.
THAAAAM!
The sudden release of force threw Kiki backward, its crimson coffin body scraping across the ground before crashing into a pile of shattered timber and stones.
KRRRSH! BOOM!
Dust rose around the impact point, while the commanders immediately began activating their ancestral techniques.
OHHHHMMMM!
Their crimson tattoos flared, releasing powerful waves of energy as eight ancestral Orc phantoms materialized around their bodies.
Unlike the earlier manifestations, these phantoms reached two hundred feet in height, towering over the surrounding battlefield while carrying the same weapons used by their original bodies.
Gurvak’s phantom possessed thick, muscular arms suited for crushing and grappling, while Brakka’s carried two enormous battleaxes that gleamed with concentrated energy.
Uzgor’s ancestral form held a long spear, Drukon’s body radiated ritual energy, and the remaining commanders manifested their own distinctive weapons and combat characteristics.
The combined pressure of eight Peak B-Rank existences immediately spread across the clearing, causing the surrounding debris to tremble as their gigantic bodies settled into position.
"You will pay for killing our kin!"

chapters.title: Chapter 385: Eight Peak B-Ranks Attack One Vorthar Clone!
paragraphs: One of the commanders roared toward Luke, prompting the others to raise their weapons.
"ATTACK HIM!"
FWHOOOOOSH!
Eight attacks immediately crossed the battlefield, including gigantic axes, a spear, concentrated curses, and other powerful techniques aimed directly at Luke’s main body.
The surrounding air distorted beneath their combined force, and several nearby Orcs hurriedly moved aside to avoid being caught in the attacks’ path.
However, Luke wasn’t fighting alone.
BANG!
The Vorthar clone possessing the black halo suddenly appeared between the incoming attacks and Luke’s main body.
He crossed both arms in front of his chest, while the black halo behind his head released a wave of dense Void Energy.
"Void Horizon!"
OHHHHMMMM!
A dark spatial layer immediately formed in front of the clone, stretching the distance the eight attacks needed to cross before reaching him.
BOOOOM! BAAAAANG! BAMMMM!
The attacks slammed into the distorted region, generating a series of violent shockwaves as their destructive power struggled against the spatial restriction.

However, these were attacks from eight Peak B-Rank commanders using their strongest ancestral manifestations, far more powerful than the ordinary punches previously thrown by the hundred B-Rank warriors.
The incoming weapons continued advancing through the stretched space, gradually exhausting the protection provided by Void Horizon.
KRRRUMBLE!
The surrounding air trembled violently as the attacks finally crossed the remaining distance.
Then they struck the clone.
BOOOOOOM!
The combined impact blasted the seventy-foot Vorthar body backward, sending him crashing directly into the ground.
BAAAAAAANG!
The collision tore open the already damaged earth, scattering broken stones and debris while a thick cloud of dust erupted from the newly formed crater.
Several nearby Orcs staggered beneath the resulting shockwave, while the eight commanders watched the impact with satisfied expressions.
"HAH! THAT SHOULD TEACH HIM!"
Unfortunately for them, Luke’s main body barely reacted.
His rainbow-halo clone also continued maintaining the seals around the hundred B-Rank warriors, although the immense energy consumption was steadily weakening those restraints.
Meanwhile, the original Luke had already begun gathering Force for another Heaven’s Palm.
Seeing this, the commanders became confused.
’Doesn’t he care that his clone was just destroyed?’
However, before anyone could voice that question, a strange movement suddenly came from the crater.
KRRRSH!
The broken stones covering its center shifted.
Then a large hand emerged from beneath the debris, followed by the seventy-foot Vorthar clone rising to his feet.
The eight commanders stared at him.
Despite having received their combined attack, the clone’s body appeared almost completely unharmed, with only dust and fragments of shattered earth covering its surface.
"HOW?!"
"HE TOOK ALL EIGHT ATTACKS!"
Several commanders were visibly astonished, since even one of them would have suffered considerable damage after receiving such a powerful combined assault.
Yet the Vorthar clone had somehow endured it.
Unfortunately, before they could understand what had happened, the clone suddenly kicked against the ground.
BOOM!
Its seventy-foot body shot out of the crater, scattering the surrounding debris as it rushed directly toward Gurvak’s two-hundred-foot ancestral phantom.
Gurvak immediately turned toward the approaching Titan.
"YOU WANT TO FIGHT ME?!"
The Vorthar clone answered by driving its right fist directly into the enormous phantom’s face.
BAAAAAANG!
The blow struck Gurvak’s jaw, producing a powerful shockwave that spread across the surrounding clearing and sent loose stones scattering over the ground.
However, despite the force behind the punch, Gurvak’s head only shifted slightly to one side.
’What?’
The Orc commander became confused.
Although the clone possessed impressive durability, its actual striking power seemed considerably weaker than he had expected.
’That punch was only around Mid B-Rank.’
For a genuine Peak B-Rank warrior, particularly one enhanced by a two-hundred-foot ancestral phantom, such an attack was hardly threatening.
Gurvak’s confusion quickly disappeared, replaced by a savage grin.
"Hahaha! So you’re nothing but a tough punching bag!"
He immediately reached forward with both enormous hands, grabbing the clone’s arms before it could retreat.
KRRRKKK!
The phantom’s thick fingers tightened around the Titan’s wrists, locking them in place as Gurvak exerted his full strength.
"LET’S SEE HOW HARD THAT HEAD OF YOURS REALLY IS!"
Without giving the clone time to respond, Gurvak pulled it toward himself and brought his own head crashing forward.
BOOOOOOOOM!
The headbutt landed directly against the Vorthar clone’s forehead, releasing a violent shockwave that tore across the nearby ground and caused several surrounding Orcs to stumble.
KRRRRAAAACK!
The earth fractured beneath the two giants, while dust and broken stones were thrown outward by the force of the collision.
The clone’s head jerked backward sharply.
However, to Gurvak’s astonishment, it immediately returned to its original position without suffering any visible injury.
For a moment, Gurvak simply stared.
Then his expression changed as he finally understood what kind of opponent he was facing.
"This giant form has incredible defense, but its attacks are weak!" he shouted toward the other commanders. "ALL OF YOU, GO AFTER THE REAL ONE! I’LL KEEP THIS CLONE OCCUPIED!"
Hearing his words, the remaining seven commanders immediately turned toward Luke’s main body.
Several even began smiling again, since they had finally discovered what appeared to be a weakness in the Hero’s strange transformation.
"So that’s how it is!"
"THEN LET’S KILL THE ORIGINAL!"
Even Gorzak, watching from outside the dome, felt somewhat relieved.
"Hah! So that giant isn’t as powerful as it looks."
However, the Orcs had apparently celebrated a little too early.
"Kiki!
A cheerful cry suddenly echoed from the ruined section of the clearing.
The commanders instinctively turned toward the source, where the twenty-five-foot crimson coffin had finally recovered from being thrown backward.
Kiki was looking directly toward Luke’s three bodies.
For some reason, it sounded particularly pleased with itself, as though it had finally completed the task Luke had entrusted to it.
Then its crimson body suddenly began dissolving.
FWHOOOSH!
The coffin collapsed into flowing black energy before disappearing from its original position.

Immediately afterward, pitch-black liquid armor began spreading across all three Vorthar Titans, covering their bodies as the familiar plates of Valzareth rapidly formed over their limbs, chests, and shoulders.
VMMMMMM!
The sudden change immediately drew the attention of the surrounding commanders, although none of them understood what Luke was preparing.
Gurvak, who was still holding the black-halo clone by both arms, suddenly felt an unexpected surge of strength coming from the Titan’s body.
’What?!’
The muscles beneath the clone’s newly formed armor tightened, and the force pressing against Gurvak’s grip increased considerably.
His expression changed.
’Its strength just increased?!’
Before he could respond, the space around the clone suddenly rippled.
FWHOOOSH!
The seventy-foot Titan disappeared directly from Gurvak’s grasp.
Gurvak instinctively tightened his hands, only to discover that he was holding nothing.
He immediately looked around, unable to understand how the giant had escaped his grip despite the ancestral formation restricting spatial movement.
Outside the dome, Vradok watched the sudden disappearance and released a troubled sigh.
"So he can still use spatial movement within the formation..."
Gorzak immediately turned toward him.
"What do you mean? Didn’t you say that barrier could stop him from escaping?"

"It can," Vradok replied, keeping his gaze fixed upon the battlefield. "The formation restricts spatial movement across its boundary, but it doesn’t completely suppress spatial techniques used within the enclosed region."
He paused briefly before adding, "The original ancestral formation possessed stronger spatial restrictions, but the version inherited by our tribe is incomplete."
Hearing that explanation, Gorzak’s expression became ugly again.
Kroghar also frowned, although he understood the problem.
Spatial manipulators had been exceedingly rare even during ancient times, and none of them had expected this D-Rank Hero to possess such unusual abilities.
Moreover, Luke’s Void Horizon relied upon manipulating the distance within space itself, making it particularly troublesome for a formation that didn’t completely suppress spatial interference.

Had the dome possessed the full restrictions of its original version, techniques such as Void Horizon would have been considerably more difficult to maintain, while internal spatial movement might have become impossible.
Unfortunately, their current formation couldn’t accomplish that.
"I just hope those commanders can kill him," Vradok finally muttered. "If capturing him proves too difficult, eliminating him will be enough."
Gorzak and Kroghar remained silent as they continued watching the battlefield, waiting to see whether their assembled forces could finally overwhelm the troublesome Hero.
Meanwhile, Emberlyn also continued observing from her concealed position, hoping Luke would find an opportunity to escape the dome so she could intervene without provoking the three A-Rank leaders.
The four Titan spirits remained quiet as well, understanding that Luke was now controlling three bodies simultaneously and couldn’t afford unnecessary distractions.
Even the System had fallen silent, showing little interest in the battle compared to the matters involving women that normally attracted its attention.

sentences.text: One of the commanders roared toward Luke, prompting the others to raise their weapons.
"ATTACK HIM!"
FWHOOOOOSH!
Eight attacks immediately crossed the battlefield, including gigantic axes, a spear, concentrated curses, and other powerful techniques aimed directly at Luke’s main body.
The surrounding air distorted beneath their combined force, and several nearby Orcs hurriedly moved aside to avoid being caught in the attacks’ path.
However, Luke wasn’t fighting alone.
BANG!
The Vorthar clone possessing the black halo suddenly appeared between the incoming attacks and Luke’s main body.
He crossed both arms in front of his chest, while the black halo behind his head released a wave of dense Void Energy.
"Void Horizon!"
OHHHHMMMM!
A dark spatial layer immediately formed in front of the clone, stretching the distance the eight attacks needed to cross before reaching him.
BOOOOM!
BAAAAANG!
BAMMMM!
The attacks slammed into the distorted region, generating a series of violent shockwaves as their destructive power struggled against the spatial restriction.

However, these were attacks from eight Peak B-Rank commanders using their strongest ancestral manifestations, far more powerful than the ordinary punches previously thrown by the hundred B-Rank warriors.
The incoming weapons continued advancing through the stretched space, gradually exhausting the protection provided by Void Horizon.
KRRRUMBLE!
The surrounding air trembled violently as the attacks finally crossed the remaining distance.
Then they struck the clone.
BOOOOOOM!
The combined impact blasted the seventy-foot Vorthar body backward, sending him crashing directly into the ground.
BAAAAAAANG!
The collision tore open the already damaged earth, scattering broken stones and debris while a thick cloud of dust erupted from the newly formed crater.
Several nearby Orcs staggered beneath the resulting shockwave, while the eight commanders watched the impact with satisfied expressions.
"HAH!
THAT SHOULD TEACH HIM!"
Unfortunately for them, Luke’s main body barely reacted.
His rainbow-halo clone also continued maintaining the seals around the hundred B-Rank warriors, although the immense energy consumption was steadily weakening those restraints.
Meanwhile, the original Luke had already begun gathering Force for another Heaven’s Palm.
Seeing this, the commanders became confused.
’Doesn’t he care that his clone was just destroyed?’
However, before anyone could voice that question, a strange movement suddenly came from the crater.
KRRRSH!
The broken stones covering its center shifted.
Then a large hand emerged from beneath the debris, followed by the seventy-foot Vorthar clone rising to his feet.
The eight commanders stared at him.
Despite having received their combined attack, the clone’s body appeared almost completely unharmed, with only dust and fragments of shattered earth covering its surface.
"HOW?!"
"HE TOOK ALL EIGHT ATTACKS!"
Several commanders were visibly astonished, since even one of them would have suffered considerable damage after receiving such a powerful combined assault.
Yet the Vorthar clone had somehow endured it.
Unfortunately, before they could understand what had happened, the clone suddenly kicked against the ground.
BOOM!
Its seventy-foot body shot out of the crater, scattering the surrounding debris as it rushed directly toward Gurvak’s two-hundred-foot ancestral phantom.
Gurvak immediately turned toward the approaching Titan.
"YOU WANT TO FIGHT ME?!"
The Vorthar clone answered by driving its right fist directly into the enormous phantom’s face.
BAAAAAANG!
The blow struck Gurvak’s jaw, producing a powerful shockwave that spread across the surrounding clearing and sent loose stones scattering over the ground.
However, despite the force behind the punch, Gurvak’s head only shifted slightly to one side.
’What?’
The Orc commander became confused.
Although the clone possessed impressive durability, its actual striking power seemed considerably weaker than he had expected.
’That punch was only around Mid B-Rank.’
For a genuine Peak B-Rank warrior, particularly one enhanced by a two-hundred-foot ancestral phantom, such an attack was hardly threatening.
Gurvak’s confusion quickly disappeared, replaced by a savage grin.
"Hahaha!
So you’re nothing but a tough punching bag!"
He immediately reached forward with both enormous hands, grabbing the clone’s arms before it could retreat.
KRRRKKK!
The phantom’s thick fingers tightened around the Titan’s wrists, locking them in place as Gurvak exerted his full strength.
"LET’S SEE HOW HARD THAT HEAD OF YOURS REALLY IS!"
Without giving the clone time to respond, Gurvak pulled it toward himself and brought his own head crashing forward.
BOOOOOOOOM!
The headbutt landed directly against the Vorthar clone’s forehead, releasing a violent shockwave that tore across the nearby ground and caused several surrounding Orcs to stumble.
KRRRRAAAACK!
The earth fractured beneath the two giants, while dust and broken stones were thrown outward by the force of the collision.
The clone’s head jerked backward sharply.
However, to Gurvak’s astonishment, it immediately returned to its original position without suffering any visible injury.
For a moment, Gurvak simply stared.
Then his expression changed as he finally understood what kind of opponent he was facing.
"This giant form has incredible defense, but its attacks are weak!" he shouted toward the other commanders.
"ALL OF YOU, GO AFTER THE REAL ONE!
I’LL KEEP THIS CLONE OCCUPIED!"
Hearing his words, the remaining seven commanders immediately turned toward Luke’s main body.
Several even began smiling again, since they had finally discovered what appeared to be a weakness in the Hero’s strange transformation.
"So that’s how it is!"
"THEN LET’S KILL THE ORIGINAL!"
Even Gorzak, watching from outside the dome, felt somewhat relieved.
"Hah!
So that giant isn’t as powerful as it looks."
However, the Orcs had apparently celebrated a little too early.
"Kiki!
A cheerful cry suddenly echoed from the ruined section of the clearing.
The commanders instinctively turned toward the source, where the twenty-five-foot crimson coffin had finally recovered from being thrown backward.
Kiki was looking directly toward Luke’s three bodies.
For some reason, it sounded particularly pleased with itself, as though it had finally completed the task Luke had entrusted to it.
Then its crimson body suddenly began dissolving.
FWHOOOSH!
The coffin collapsed into flowing black energy before disappearing from its original position.

Immediately afterward, pitch-black liquid armor began spreading across all three Vorthar Titans, covering their bodies as the familiar plates of Valzareth rapidly formed over their limbs, chests, and shoulders.

chapters.title: Chapter 386: The Anvil Titan’s Origin Authority Enters Battle!
paragraphs: OHHHHMMMM!

Eight Peak B-Rank auras erupted across the ruined battlefield as the Orc commanders began gathering their strongest attacks, causing the surrounding air to tremble while crimson energy surged through their two-hundred-foot ancestral phantoms.

Gurvak stood at the front, his muscular phantom clenching both fists as dense ancestral energy gathered around his arms, while Brakka raised her enormous battleaxes, their blades growing increasingly brighter beneath the crimson dome.

Beside them, Uzgor positioned his spear for a powerful thrust, whereas Drukon began chanting an ancient incantation, sending strange markings from his staff into the weapons of the remaining commanders.

"Don’t give him another opportunity to escape!" Brukha shouted, raising her weapon toward Luke. "Everyone, release your attacks together, and make sure you don’t leave him enough space to use that damned teleportation!"
The other commanders immediately responded, their combined pressure continuing to increase as the energy gathering around their weapons became increasingly unstable.
Meanwhile, Luke remained floating above the devastated clearing, his seventy-foot Vorthar body covered in Valzareth Armor, while the golden-white halo behind his head rotated steadily.
Below him, the black-halo clone had already returned to his side, while the rainbow-halo clone was still struggling to maintain Sevaroth’s seals upon the hundred B-Rank Orcs.
’They’re finally cooperating.’
Luke glanced at the eight commanders before raising his head toward the crimson dome, whose ancient markings continued circulating across the sky.
A faint smile appeared on his face.
’Since they’re so eager to attack me, why don’t I let them help?’
He immediately sent a thought toward his black-halo clone, which responded by raising its right hand.
"Void Horizon."
VMMMMMMMM!
An invisible spatial distortion spread across the air in front of Luke, gradually stretching the distance between him and the approaching commanders.
However, rather than using the technique solely for defense, the clone positioned the distorted region along the path of their incoming attacks, giving Luke enough time to prepare his next movement.
Below, Drukon finally completed his incantation.
"NOW!"
Brukha’s furious shout echoed across the battlefield.
BOOOOM!
Gurvak released a gigantic ancestral fist formed from concentrated physical energy, while Brakka crossed her battleaxes and unleashed two crimson slashes that tore through the surrounding air.
Uzgor thrust his spear forward, sending a concentrated spear projection toward Luke, whereas Drukon’s ritual energy accompanied the attacks, strengthening their destructive force.
The remaining commanders released their techniques almost simultaneously, producing a combined wave of energy that swept across the ruined clearing.
FWHOOOOOOOSH!
The attacks approached Luke from several directions, their overlapping pressure crushing the air as they converged upon his position.
Several nearby Orcs hurriedly retreated, unwilling to be caught in the destructive force released by their own commanders.
"HE’S FINISHED!"
"THERE’S NO WAY HE CAN SURVIVE THAT!"
However, Luke’s expression remained surprisingly calm.
’Almost...’
He waited until the leading attacks entered the distorted region created by Void Horizon, watching their speed decrease as the stretched space delayed their advance.
Unfortunately, the technique was already trembling beneath their combined strength.
KRRRRUMBLE!
Dark ripples spread across the invisible spatial boundary, while the black halo behind his clone began releasing increasingly intense Void Energy.
’Now!’
Luke activated Void Step.
FWHOOOSH!
His seventy-foot body disappeared from its original position, reappearing several hundred feet higher and closer to the upper section of the crimson dome.
The black-halo clone followed immediately, abandoning the distorted region just before the eight attacks finally broke through.
BOOOOOOM!
With nothing remaining to stop their advance, the combined techniques continued along their original trajectory and struck the inner surface of the dome.
KRRRRRRRUMBLE!
A violent explosion spread across the crimson barrier, causing the ancient markings around the impact point to flare as the formation struggled to disperse the concentrated energy.

The dome remained intact, but the collision released a destructive shockwave into the surrounding region, throwing several nearby ancestral phantoms backward as the pressure swept across the battlefield.
"AAAAARGHH!"
"GET DOWN!"
The nearest Orcs hurriedly raised their weapons or activated defensive techniques, while several weaker phantoms flickered as the shockwave passed through their bodies.
Unfortunately, Luke had never expected the combined attack to destroy the dome.
He merely needed the commanders to waste their strongest techniques while providing him another opportunity to attack the army below.
’Thanks for the help.’
He immediately looked toward the eastern side of the battlefield, where hundreds of ancestral phantoms formed from lower-ranked Orcs were preparing to advance.
Then he raised his right hand.
"Heaven Forge"
OHHHHMMMM!
An unusual radiance gathered around Luke’s palm as the Origin Authority belonging to the Anvil Titan awakened, causing the surrounding space to tremble beneath the energy he began gathering.
Within that radiance, two different powers appeared.
One was the golden-white Cosmic Energy belonging to Caelith, which rapidly condensed into several elongated celestial constructs, while the other was the darkness of Nyx’s Authority of Severance.
"Cosmic Construct"
"Physical Severance"
The two abilities entered Heaven Forge, where their energies began merging into a single structure rather than remaining as separate techniques.
VMMMMMMMM!

The golden-white constructs gradually darkened along their edges, forming several gigantic crescent-shaped blades whose surfaces carried the concentrated properties of both Cosmic matter and Physical Severance.
Their appearance caused the surrounding air to ripple, while thin black lines appeared wherever their edges passed through space.
Luke looked toward the clustered ancestral phantoms below.
’Let’s see how these perform.’
He swept his hand sideways.
FWHIIIIIIIIISH!
The celestial blades immediately shot toward the eastern army, traveling in a broad arc that brought them directly into contact with the first line of gigantic Orc phantoms.
"INCOMING ATTACK!"
"RAISE YOUR DEFENSES!"
Several phantoms crossed their arms and gathered crimson energy around their bodies, preparing to withstand what appeared to be another ordinary ranged technique.
Unfortunately, the first celestial blade struck before they could complete their defenses.
SHHHRRRAAAK!
A thin black line passed through the nearest phantom’s raised arms, severing the manifested flesh and bone before continuing directly through its torso.
For an instant, the enormous ancestral warrior remained standing.
Then its upper body slipped sideways.
KRRRRAAAACK!
The severed phantom collapsed, its crimson manifestation breaking apart as the Orcs sustaining it were struck by the remaining destructive energy.
"AAAAARGHH!"
The second celestial blade arrived almost immediately, cutting through another group of ancestral phantoms before striking the ground behind them.
BOOOOOOM!
A deep trench opened across the battlefield as the attack continued forward, tearing through earth, broken trees, and several smaller formations caught along its path.
The remaining blades spread across different sections of the army, their black-edged surfaces carving through the gigantic manifestations with terrifying efficiency.
SHRRRRAAAK! KRRRSH! BOOOOM!
Within seconds, several lines of ancestral phantoms were cut apart, while the ground beneath them became covered in deep, intersecting trenches.
Some Orcs attempted to strengthen their defenses through their ancestral tattoos, but the Severance carried by the forged blades continued cutting through the physical structures they manifested.
"WHAT KIND OF WEAPON IS THAT?!"
"OUR ANCESTRAL BODIES ARE BEING CUT APART!"
The surrounding warriors immediately began retreating, although the crowded arrangement of their formations made escaping the attack extremely difficult.
Meanwhile, Luke watched the destruction with obvious satisfaction.
’Oh, that’s good.’

The technique had consumed a considerable amount of energy, but compared to repeatedly summoning Heaven’s Palm, its ability to cut through several enemies along a single trajectory made it particularly useful against tightly packed formations.
More importantly, the destruction immediately produced the result he wanted.
FWHOOOSH!
Blood and fragments of flesh began gathering from the devastated sections of the battlefield, reconstructing the slain Orcs for an instant before compressing their remains into Blood Essence Pills.
"AAAAAAAHHH!"
The agonized screams spread across the surrounding region, causing several surviving warriors to stagger backward as they witnessed their fallen companions being converted into cultivation resources.
Streams of crimson light flew toward Luke, disappearing into his body while the System displayed the resulting progress.
Luke glanced toward the numbers.
’Finally crossed five percent.’
A pleased smile appeared on his face as he turned toward another densely gathered section of the Orc army.
Unfortunately, the eight commanders had finally recovered from the failure of their combined attack.
"YOU DAMNED MONSTER!"
Gurvak roared furiously upon seeing the destruction caused by Luke’s celestial blades, while Brukha immediately began ordering the surviving warriors to separate their formations.
"SPREAD OUT! DON’T LET HIM STRIKE SO MANY OF YOU AT ONCE!"
However, before her orders could reach the distant troops, Luke had already disappeared.
FWHOOOSH!
A dark spatial ripple opened above the northern side of the battlefield.
Then the seventy-foot Vorthar appeared directly above a group of ancestral phantoms, his right hand already gathering another concentration of Cosmic Energy.
"Cosmic Lock."
OHHHHMMMM!
The celestial bodies within Luke’s Cosmic System immediately shifted, aligning their gravitational influence toward the clustered phantoms below.
Within seconds, an intense gravitational pressure descended upon the targeted region, causing the enormous Orc bodies to stagger as the ground beneath their feet began sinking.
KRRRRRUMBLE!
"UGGHH!"
"WE CAN’T MOVE!"
Several phantoms attempted to raise their weapons, but the concentrated gravitational force made even moving their arms increasingly difficult.
Unfortunately for them, Luke wasn’t finished.
"Seal of Restraint"
The golden-white halo behind his head briefly flashed with Sevaroth’s sealing energy, and several radiant shackles materialized around the nearest phantoms’ limbs.

Although the seals couldn’t completely immobilize so many B-Rank-level manifestations, their additional restrictions disrupted the movements of the strongest targets long enough for Cosmic Lock to concentrate its pressure.
Luke smiled.
’Good. Now stay there.’

chapters.title: Chapter 387: Heaven Forge—A New Combination Is Coming!
paragraphs: He raised his left hand toward the celestial bodies floating above him.
Several asteroids immediately accelerated along their orbital paths, leaving golden-white trails through the air as they descended toward the trapped phantoms.
FWHOOOOOOSH!
The leading asteroid struck the first ancestral warrior directly in the chest.
BOOOOOOM!
Its enormous body was thrown backward, crashing into the phantoms standing behind it as the impact released a violent shockwave.
Before those warriors could recover, the remaining asteroids descended.
BOOM! BOOOOM! KRRRRAAAACK!

One struck the ground between two phantoms, opening a wide crater as the resulting explosion tore through their lower bodies, while another smashed directly into a phantom’s head and shattered its crimson manifestation.
The surviving warriors desperately struggled against the gravitational pressure, attempting to escape before the next celestial body reached them.

However, Luke continued directing the asteroids through the crowded formation, using their destructive impacts to break apart the ancestral bodies while the surrounding gravitational field prevented the Orcs from scattering.
"AAAAARGHH!"
"HELP US!"
The cries of the trapped Orcs spread across the battlefield, while the nearby commanders watched another section of their army being destroyed.
Brukha’s expression became increasingly furious.

"Energy Severance"

The blow struck Uzgor’s waist, forcing the phantom to stagger as the impact released a powerful shockwave.
Although the damage wasn’t enough to seriously injure a Peak B-Rank warrior, Luke immediately followed the attack with a different technique.
"Seal of Silence"
White-gold threads suddenly appeared around Uzgor’s right arm, rapidly weaving across the ancestral markings responsible for channeling energy into his spear.
"UGH! WHAT IS THIS?!"
The commander’s attempt to manifest another weapon immediately faltered, and before he could tear apart the threads, the clone drove its left palm toward his chest.
"Physical Severance"
SHHHHRAAAK!
A black line tore across the ancestral phantom’s torso, opening a deep wound through its manifested flesh.
"AAAAARGHH!"
Uzgor stumbled backward, his expression twisting with pain as the damage transferred through the ancestral connection and injured his original body.
Blood spilled from his mouth.
"YOU BASTARD!"
He immediately gathered his remaining strength, forcing crimson energy through the damaged tattoos until the white-gold threads began tearing apart.
KRRRKKK!
However, the clone had already retreated through Void Step.
Uzgor could only watch as the seventy-foot Titan disappeared, leaving him clutching his injured chest while the wound across his ancestral phantom continued leaking crimson energy.
"WHAT ARE THOSE THINGS?!"
High above the battlefield, Gorzak stared at the destruction unfolding beneath the dome, his earlier confidence almost completely gone.

He had expected the Hero to rely upon a handful of powerful techniques, but Luke was now using abilities belonging to completely different systems, combining them in ways that shouldn’t have been possible for a single cultivator.
"First the space, then those celestial bodies, and now he’s using sealing techniques as well!"
Kroghar remained silent for several seconds, carefully observing how Luke’s three bodies coordinated their attacks.
The most troubling part wasn’t merely the number of abilities being displayed.

It was the fact that the Hero could use those abilities simultaneously through his clones, allowing him to attack the weaker army while preventing the Peak B-Rank commanders from approaching his main body.
"He’s deliberately avoiding a prolonged battle with our commanders," Kroghar finally said.
Gorzak turned toward him.
"What?"
"Look at where his strongest attacks are landing."
Kroghar gestured toward the devastated sections of the battlefield.
"He’s using his clones to occupy our strongest warriors while his main body continues killing the lower-ranked troops."
Vradok had already noticed the same thing.
Moreover, the Great Shaman was becoming increasingly disturbed by the strange crimson pills appearing whenever the Hero killed their warriors.
’He’s growing stronger from killing them.’
The realization made his expression darken.
For the first time, Vradok began wondering whether gathering so many warriors inside the dome had been a mistake.
Meanwhile, Luke’s rainbow-halo clone was facing a different problem.
The hundred B-Rank Orcs previously restrained by Sevaroth’s seals had gradually begun breaking free, since maintaining restrictions against so many opponents had consumed too much energy.
KRRRRAAAK!
Another golden shackle shattered, allowing a High B-Rank Orc to pull his arm free before immediately striking the dark-blue rings suppressing his strength.
BOOM!
The rings trembled violently.
"EVERYONE! BREAK THESE DAMNED SEALS!"
Several nearby warriors followed his example, concentrating their remaining energy into their bodies as they attempted to destroy the restraints.
Unfortunately, Luke had already noticed the growing instability.
’Keeping all hundred sealed is wasting too much energy.’
He immediately changed his strategy.
Instead of continuing to suppress every warrior, the rainbow-halo clone withdrew most of its sealing energy, allowing dozens of Orcs to regain their movements.
"HAHAHA! WE’RE FREE!"
The warriors immediately raised their weapons, believing that Luke’s clone had finally exhausted its strength.
However, the moment they began charging, the rainbow halo behind the clone flashed again.
"Seal of Restraint"
Golden shackles suddenly appeared around the wrists and ankles of the nearest Orcs, interrupting their movements just as they attempted to activate their ancestral phantoms.
KRRRKKK!
"UGHH!"
Before the remaining warriors could assist them, the clone extended its other hand.
"Cosmic Lock"
OHHHHMMMM!
A concentrated gravitational field descended upon a smaller group of B-Rank Orcs, forcing their bodies downward as the golden shackles tightened around their limbs.
Unlike the earlier attempt to suppress all hundred warriors simultaneously, this time Luke concentrated his power on only a handful of targets.
The difference was immediate.
Several Orcs fell to their knees, their movements almost completely restricted as the gravitational pressure prevented them from breaking the shackles.
"NOW!"
The surrounding warriors attempted to attack the clone, but before they could close the distance, black spatial ripples appeared between them.
FWHOOOSH!
The black-halo clone returned.
Without wasting time, it drove its armored fist toward the nearest restrained Orc.
BAAAAAANG!
The blow struck the warrior directly in the chest, breaking several ribs as the combined physical force of Vorthar and Valzareth sent him crashing into the ground.
"AAAAARGHH!"
The clone immediately stepped forward and delivered another punch, this time concentrating Physical Severance along the striking surface.
SHHHRAAAK!
The attack tore through the Orc’s weakened defenses, leaving a deep wound across his torso as his remaining ancestral energy scattered.
However, another B-Rank warrior was already approaching from the side.
"GET AWAY FROM HIM!"
The Orc swung his enormous weapon toward the clone’s head, intending to interrupt the attack.
Unfortunately, the rainbow-halo clone immediately activated the Seal of Silence.
White-gold threads appeared around the attacking warrior’s hands, interfering with the energy flowing into his weapon and causing its crimson radiance to weaken.
"What?!"
Before he could recover, the black-halo clone turned and struck his abdomen with a powerful kick.
BOOOOM!
The impact sent the warrior crashing backward through the ruined earth, leaving a long trench beneath his body before he finally stopped.
Luke didn’t continue pursuing him.

Instead, both clones immediately shifted their attention toward another group of approaching Orcs, using their coordinated abilities to keep the B-Rank warriors occupied while the main body continued attacking the lower-ranked army.
Unfortunately for the hundred Orcs, they were slowly discovering that the two clones were far more dangerous when concentrating their abilities upon smaller groups.
Meanwhile, Luke’s main body had already moved toward the western side of the battlefield.
There, several hundred ancestral phantoms had gathered behind Molgar’s defensive formation, whose enormous crimson body was standing at the front with both arms raised.
"EVERYONE, STAY BEHIND ME!" Molgar shouted, his defensive phantom radiating dense ancestral energy as an enormous protective barrier formed before the gathered warriors.
The surrounding Orcs immediately obeyed, moving into position behind the defensive formation while several C-Rank Shamans began strengthening its surface.
VMMMMMMMM!
Crimson markings appeared across the barrier, gradually forming overlapping layers intended to withstand Luke’s celestial attacks.
Seeing this, Luke couldn’t help smiling.
’Oh? A shield?’
He examined the barrier briefly before raising his right hand.
’Perfect. Let’s test another combination.’
"Heaven Forge"
