chapters.title: Chapter 388: “HOW MANY FORMS DOES THIS BASTARD HAVE?!”
paragraphs: OHHHHMMMM!
Golden-white Cosmic Energy gathered around his palm, forming a long, narrow celestial spear whose surface shimmered beneath the light of his Cosmic System.
Then black Void Energy began gathering around the construct.
"Cosmic Construct"
"Physical Severance"
"Energy Severance"
The three powers entered Heaven Forge, and the celestial spear immediately began changing as its physical structure, cosmic energy, and Severance Authority merged into a single forged weapon.
VMMMMMMMM!
Its previously golden-white surface darkened along several thin lines, while the surrounding air distorted beneath the concentrated energy flowing through its body.
Unlike the earlier crescent blades, this technique required considerably more control, since Luke was combining three different powers into one concentrated attack.
However, the result was far more dangerous.
Luke slowly lowered his arm, aiming the forged spear directly toward Molgar's defensive formation.
'Let's see how strong that shield really is.'
Then he threw it.
FWHIIIIIIIIISH!
The celestial spear shot forward, leaving a narrow trail of distorted air as it crossed the distance toward the defensive barrier.
Molgar immediately sensed the danger.
"BRACE!"
OHHHHMMMM!
The enormous protective barrier flared with crimson radiance as the Orc commander poured additional energy into its surface.
Then the forged spear struck.
KRRRRRAAAAAANG!
A violent shockwave erupted from the point of collision, causing the entire defensive formation to tremble as the concentrated attack attempted to penetrate its layered protection.
For an instant, Molgar successfully resisted.
However, the dark lines running along the spear suddenly spread across the barrier's surface.
SHHHHRAAAK!
The Physical Severance began cutting through its reinforced structure, while Energy Severance interfered with the crimson power maintaining the protective layers.
Cracks rapidly appeared.
"What?!"
Molgar's expression changed.
"EVERYONE, GIVE ME MORE ENERGY!"
The Shamans behind him immediately increased their output, causing the barrier to brighten as they attempted to repair the damaged sections.
Unfortunately, the spear had already penetrated too deeply.
KRRRRAAAACK!
The first defensive layer shattered.
Then the second.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!
The forged spear finally broke through the formation, releasing its remaining destructive force directly into the densely packed ancestral phantoms standing behind Molgar.
"AAAAARGHH!"
The leading phantoms were immediately struck, their enormous bodies breaking apart as the concentrated Severance tore through their defenses.
The resulting explosion ripped open the ground, throwing shattered stones and broken timber outward while the protective formation collapsed around its commander.
Molgar himself was blasted backward, his enormous ancestral phantom crashing through several weaker manifestations before finally striking the ground.
THAAAAAAM!
The impact sent a cloud of dust rolling across the battlefield.
"COMMANDER MOLGAR!"
Several Orcs immediately rushed toward him, only to discover that his ancestral phantom had suffered a deep wound across its chest, while his original body's left arm hung at an unnatural angle.
"UGHH!"
Molgar gritted his teeth as blood ran down his arm.
'My defense... was actually broken?'
He stared toward Luke with disbelief.
However, the Hero had already turned away, apparently more interested in the lower-ranked warriors who had been caught in the explosion.
FWHOOOSH!
Blood Essence Pills began gathering from the destroyed phantoms, their crimson light streaming across the battlefield before disappearing into Luke's body.
Luke looked at the increasing numbers with satisfaction.
'Good. At this rate, I might reach six percent soon.
Unfortunately, the surviving Orcs had finally begun understanding just how dangerous his cultivation technique was.
"HE'S GETTING STRONGER!"
"EVERYONE, DON'T LET HIM KILL ANY MORE OF US!"
Their frightened shouts spread through the surrounding army, causing several formations to begin retreating despite the commands of their officers.
However, the crimson dome continued covering the entire region, preventing anyone from escaping beyond its boundaries.
Meanwhile, Luke floated above the ruined battlefield, watching the retreating phantoms with an increasingly pleased expression.
'Hah, now they're running.'
He raised his hand again, preparing to release another attack.
Unfortunately, this time the Orc commanders had no intention of allowing him to continue.
"ENOUGH!"
Brukha's furious voice echoed across the battlefield as she directed the remaining commanders toward Luke.
Gurvak, Brakka, Uzgor, Vargut, and Garzun immediately charged, while Drukon began preparing another ritual from behind them.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Their two-hundred-foot ancestral phantoms crossed the shattered terrain, kicking up clouds of dust as their combined auras pressed toward Luke.
However, instead of retreating, Luke slowly lowered his hand.
'All right, let's deal with you for a while.'
His golden-white halo flashed.
"Form Assimilation"
VMMMM!

The structure of his right forearm suddenly began changing beneath Valzareth, its muscles becoming denser as he assimilated the powerful physical characteristics of Behemor into his current Vorthar body.
At the same time, two enormous silver wings emerged from his back, carrying the aerial characteristics of Sylvarion.
FWHOOOSH!
The wings spread outward, stirring the surrounding air as Luke adjusted his position above the approaching commanders.
Brakka immediately noticed the change.
"WINGS?!"
Her expression became increasingly irritated.
"HOW MANY FORMS DOES THIS BASTARD HAVE?!"
Unfortunately, Luke had no intention of answering.
He suddenly folded his wings backward and accelerated.
BOOOOM!
His seventy-foot body shot toward Brakka, crossing the distance between them before the female commander could properly adjust her battleaxes.
"HAAH!"
Luke drove his strengthened fist directly toward her ancestral phantom's abdomen.
BAAAAAANG!
The blow struck with tremendous force, causing Brakka's two-hundred-foot body to bend forward as the impact sent a powerful shockwave through the surrounding air.
"UGGHH!"
Before she could retaliate, Luke twisted his body and delivered another punch toward her exposed side.
BOOOOOOM!
The second blow forced her enormous phantom to stagger, its feet tearing through the ground as she struggled to maintain her balance.
However, Brakka was still a Peak B-Rank commander.
"YOU THINK YOU CAN BEAT ME IN CLOSE COMBAT?!"
She immediately swung one of her enormous battleaxes toward Luke's neck, while the second approached from below, intending to trap him between both blades.
FWHOOOOOSH!
Luke noticed the approaching attacks and activated Void Step.
VMMMM!
His body disappeared from between the weapons, causing the two battleaxes to collide with each other.
KRRRRAAAANG!
The resulting shockwave shook the surrounding clearing.
Before Brakka could recover, Luke reappeared directly above her shoulder.
"Seal of Restraint"
Golden shackles suddenly materialized around her right wrist, tightening just as she attempted to raise her battleaxe.
"WHAT?!"
The restraint lasted only briefly against her Peak B-Rank strength, but that instant was enough.
Luke brought his right leg downward.
BAAAAAAANG!
His armored heel struck Brakka's shoulder, forcing her enormous body toward the ground as cracks spread across her ancestral manifestation.
"AAAAARGHH!"
Brakka staggered, her right arm temporarily losing strength as the combined impact damaged her shoulder.
However, Luke immediately sensed another powerful presence approaching from behind.
'Gurvak!'
The broad-shouldered commander lunged toward him with both enormous arms extended, intending to catch the seventy-foot Titan before he could retreat.
Unfortunately, Luke had already anticipated the attack.
'Void Horizon.'
VMMMM!
The space between Gurvak's hands and Luke suddenly stretched, causing the enormous fingers to close around empty air.
"What?!"
Before Gurvak could react, Luke twisted his body and drove his left fist toward the commander's exposed chest.
"Physical Severance"
SHHHHRAAAK!
A dark line appeared across the striking surface of his fist.
Then the blow landed.
BOOOOOOM!
Gurvak's ancestral phantom was thrown backward, a deep wound opening across its chest as crimson energy scattered from the damaged section.
"UGGHH!"
The enormous Orc crashed through the ruined ground, leaving a long trench behind his body before finally coming to a stop.
However, Luke didn't pursue him.
Instead, he raised his head toward the approaching lower-ranked army, where thousands of ancestral phantoms were still gathering near the northern side of the battlefield.
'Those are worth more than wasting time fighting these commanders.'
He immediately accelerated upward, spreading Sylvarion's wings as he moved above the clustered formations.
Unfortunately, Uzgor had already prepared another attack.
"YOU WON'T ESCAPE!"
FWHOOOOOSH!
A crimson spear projection shot toward Luke's back, its concentrated energy tearing through the surrounding air as it approached his exposed position.
Luke immediately turned his head.
'Tch!'
He attempted to avoid the attack, but the spear was already too close.
At that exact instant, a golden-white asteroid moved into position behind him.
BOOOOOOM!
The spear struck the celestial body, shattering it into fragments while the resulting explosion sent Luke several feet forward.
"UGHH!"
Although he avoided receiving the attack directly, the impact still caused his body to tremble beneath Valzareth.
Meanwhile, the destroyed asteroid's fragments scattered across the battlefield, their golden-white radiance gradually fading.
Uzgor immediately smiled.
"HAHA! YOU CAN'T KEEP ESCAPING FOREVER!"
Unfortunately, Luke's expression had already changed.
He looked toward the scattered fragments, and an unusual thought suddenly crossed his mind.
'Wait...'
The celestial body had existed within his presence before being destroyed.
And now, its destruction had fulfilled the condition required by another Origin Authority.
Luke slowly raised his right hand.
"Final Record"
OHHHHMMMM!
A strange, colorless radiance spread across the fragments of the destroyed asteroid, causing their movements to halt as an unfamiliar power began gathering around them.
Then the scattered pieces reversed their trajectories.
VMMMMMMMM!

Under the astonished gazes of the surrounding Orcs, the fragments began assembling in the air, their surfaces reconnecting as the destroyed celestial body was reconstructed according to its recorded state.
Within seconds, the asteroid had completely reformed.

Before she could retaliate, Luke twisted his body and delivered another punch toward her exposed side.
BOOOOOOM!
The second blow forced her enormous phantom to stagger, its feet tearing through the ground as she struggled to maintain her balance.
However, Brakka was still a Peak B-Rank commander.
"YOU THINK YOU CAN BEAT ME IN CLOSE COMBAT?!"
She immediately swung one of her enormous battleaxes toward Luke's neck, while the second approached from below, intending to trap him between both blades.
FWHOOOOOSH!
Luke noticed the approaching attacks and activated Void Step.
VMMMM!
His body disappeared from between the weapons, causing the two battleaxes to collide with each other.
KRRRRAAAANG!
The resulting shockwave shook the surrounding clearing.
Before Brakka could recover, Luke reappeared directly above her shoulder.
"Seal of Restraint"
Golden shackles suddenly materialized around her right wrist, tightening just as she attempted to raise her battleaxe.
"WHAT?!"
The restraint lasted only briefly against her Peak B-Rank strength, but that instant was enough.
Luke brought his right leg downward.
BAAAAAAANG!
His armored heel struck Brakka's shoulder, forcing her enormous body toward the ground as cracks spread across her ancestral manifestation.
"AAAAARGHH!"
Brakka staggered, her right arm temporarily losing strength as the combined impact damaged her shoulder.
However, Luke immediately sensed another powerful presence approaching from behind.
'Gurvak!'
The broad-shouldered commander lunged toward him with both enormous arms extended, intending to catch the seventy-foot Titan before he could retreat.
Unfortunately, Luke had already anticipated the attack.
'Void Horizon.'
VMMMM!
The space between Gurvak's hands and Luke suddenly stretched, causing the enormous fingers to close around empty air.
"What?!"
Before Gurvak could react, Luke twisted his body and drove his left fist toward the commander's exposed chest.
"Physical Severance"
SHHHHRAAAK!
A dark line appeared across the striking surface of his fist.
Then the blow landed.
BOOOOOOM!
Gurvak's ancestral phantom was thrown backward, a deep wound opening across its chest as crimson energy scattered from the damaged section.
"UGGHH!"
The enormous Orc crashed through the ruined ground, leaving a long trench behind his body before finally coming to a stop.
However, Luke didn't pursue him.
Instead, he raised his head toward the approaching lower-ranked army, where thousands of ancestral phantoms were still gathering near the northern side of the battlefield.
'Those are worth more than wasting time fighting these commanders.'
He immediately accelerated upward, spreading Sylvarion's wings as he moved above the clustered formations.
Unfortunately, Uzgor had already prepared another attack.
"YOU WON'T ESCAPE!"
FWHOOOOOSH!
A crimson spear projection shot toward Luke's back, its concentrated energy tearing through the surrounding air as it approached his exposed position.
Luke immediately turned his head.
'Tch!'
He attempted to avoid the attack, but the spear was already too close.
At that exact instant, a golden-white asteroid moved into position behind him.
BOOOOOOM!
The spear struck the celestial body, shattering it into fragments while the resulting explosion sent Luke several feet forward.
"UGHH!"
Although he avoided receiving the attack directly, the impact still caused his body to tremble beneath Valzareth.
Meanwhile, the destroyed asteroid's fragments scattered across the battlefield, their golden-white radiance gradually fading.
Uzgor immediately smiled.
"HAHA!
YOU CAN'T KEEP ESCAPING FOREVER!"
Unfortunately, Luke's expression had already changed.
He looked toward the scattered fragments, and an unusual thought suddenly crossed his mind.
'Wait...'
The celestial body had existed within his presence before being destroyed.
And now, its destruction had fulfilled the condition required by another Origin Authority.
Luke slowly raised his right hand.
"Final Record"
OHHHHMMMM!
A strange, colorless radiance spread across the fragments of the destroyed asteroid, causing their movements to halt as an unfamiliar power began gathering around them.
Then the scattered pieces reversed their trajectories.
VMMMMMMMM!

Under the astonished gazes of the surrounding Orcs, the fragments began assembling in the air, their surfaces reconnecting as the destroyed celestial body was reconstructed according to its recorded state.
Within seconds, the asteroid had completely reformed.

chapters.title: Chapter 389: Final Record—The Power to Reverse Destruction!
paragraphs: Uzgor stared at the restored celestial body.
"What...?"
Even the three A-Rank Orc leaders watching from above became visibly startled.
"HE CAN RESTORE DESTROYED THINGS?!" Gorzak shouted.
Unfortunately, Luke had no intention of explaining the Epitaph Titan's Authority.

He was already feeling the considerable energy expenditure required to restore the asteroid, and although the ability had succeeded, repeatedly using such a technique during a battle of this scale would place an unnecessary burden upon his Origin.
'Good. At least it worked.'
He smiled before directing the restored asteroid toward the clustered lower-ranked Orc phantoms.
FWHOOOOOSH!
The celestial body accelerated, leaving a brilliant golden-white trail through the air as it descended toward the tightly gathered formations.
"WHAT?!"
"IT'S COMING TOWARD US!"
Several phantoms attempted to retreat, but the asteroid had already crossed the distance.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!
The restored celestial body struck the center of the gathered Orcs, releasing a violent explosion that tore through several ancestral phantoms and caused the surrounding ground to collapse.
KRRRRAAAACK!

Deep fractures spread outward as the impact threw broken stones and shattered earth into the air, while the phantoms caught directly beneath it were crushed before they could properly defend themselves.
"AAAAAAAAARGHH!"
Their screams echoed across the battlefield as another section of the Orc army was destroyed.
However, Luke was already preparing his next attack.
His wings spread fully, and the golden-white halo behind his head began rotating faster as he gathered additional Cosmic Energy.
'Now, let's make this worth the trouble.'
"Heaven Forge"
OHHHHMMMM!
A brilliant radiance gathered around Luke's right fist as he began combining the concentrated force of Azrion with Caelith's Cosmic Energy.
Then Nyx's Authority of Severance entered the forming technique.
"Cosmic Punch"
"Physical Severance"
"Energy Severance"
VMMMMMMMM!
The three powers merged within Heaven Forge, causing the energy surrounding Luke's fist to compress into a single, tightly concentrated attack.
Black lines spread across the golden-white radiance, while the surrounding air distorted beneath the pressure released by the newly forged technique.
Unlike Heaven's Palm, the attack was concentrated into Luke's own fist, making it far more suitable for striking individual targets.
He looked toward Garzun, whose enormous ancestral phantom was rapidly approaching with its shield raised.
'Perfect timing.'
Garzun immediately noticed Luke's attention.
"COME ON, YOU DAMNED HERO! I'LL SHOW YOU WHAT A REAL DEFENSE LOOKS LIKE!"
He raised his enormous shield, pouring Peak B-Rank ancestral energy into its surface until crimson markings spread across the entire structure.
Then he charged forward.
THUD! THUD! THUD!
His two-hundred-foot phantom accelerated across the shattered battlefield, preparing to crush Luke beneath the reinforced shield.
Unfortunately, Luke had already begun moving.
FWHOOOOOSH!
His silver wings swept backward as he shot toward Garzun, bringing his right fist forward while the forged energy surrounding it continued intensifying.
Garzun immediately positioned his shield directly in front of his body.
"COME!"
Luke smiled.
"HAAAH!"
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The forged punch collided with the enormous ancestral shield, releasing a tremendous explosion that caused the surrounding air to tremble.
For an instant, Garzun successfully resisted.
However, the golden-white energy surrounding Luke's fist suddenly spread across the shield's surface, while thin black lines began cutting through its reinforced structure.
KRRRRRAAAACK!
The shield cracked.
"What?!"
Garzun immediately attempted to retreat, but Luke continued pressing forward, pouring additional force into his fist.
"BREAK!"
KRRRRRRAAAAAAACK!
The shield shattered directly beneath the attack.
BOOOOOOM!
The remaining force struck Garzun's chest, sending his enormous ancestral phantom flying backward as a deep wound opened across its torso.
"AAAAARGHH!"
His two-hundred-foot body crashed into the ground, tearing a long trench through the fractured earth before finally stopping near the remains of the outpost's outer wall.
THAAAAAAM!
Blood spilled from Garzun's mouth as his original body suffered the backlash from the damaged ancestral manifestation.
However, Luke didn't continue attacking him.
Instead, he turned toward the surrounding army.
'These commanders are troublesome, but they're still only eight.'
He glanced toward his two clones, which were continuing to occupy the remaining B-Rank warriors.
Then his gaze returned to the millions of lower-ranked Orcs trapped inside the dome.
'And there are still so many of them.'
A broad smile appeared on his face.
Unfortunately, that expression immediately attracted the attention of several nearby Orcs.
"HE'S SMILING AGAIN!"
"EVERYONE, GET AWAY FROM HIM!"
Their frightened shouts spread across the surrounding formations, but Luke had already raised both hands.
"Azrion's Unwritten Arts"
OHHHHMMMM!
A gigantic spectral manifestation of Azrion gradually appeared behind his seventy-foot body, while dense Force gathered in the sky above the western side of the battlefield.
Several Orcs immediately recognized the technique.
"THE HAND!"
"HE'S SUMMONING THAT DAMNED HAND AGAIN!"
Unfortunately, Luke had no intention of allowing them enough time to escape.
"First Move: Heaven's Palm"
FWHOOOOOOOSH!
A gigantic spectral hand approximately one kilometer across materialized above the crowded formations.
However, this time Luke also activated Cosmic Lock, directing the gravitational influence of his celestial bodies toward the targeted region.
OHHHHMMMM!
The enormous ancestral phantoms immediately staggered as the concentrated pressure descended upon their bodies, making it difficult for them to move away from the incoming attack.
"RUN!"
"WE CAN'T MOVE!"
Luke brought his hand downward.
"HAAAH!"
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Heaven's Palm crashed into the gathered phantoms, releasing another destructive explosion that swallowed a broad section of the battlefield.
KRRRRRRAAAACK!
The ground collapsed beneath the impact, and enormous quantities of earth were thrown outward as the spectral hand crushed the ancestral manifestations caught beneath it.
Several phantoms attempted to resist, but the combined gravitational pressure and physical Force proved too much for their temporary B-Rank-level bodies.
BOOM! BOOOM! KRRRRAAAK!
One after another, the gigantic manifestations shattered, while the warriors sustaining them were caught within the destruction.
"AAAAAAAAAAAHHH!"
Their agonized cries spread across the battlefield, accompanied by the thunderous sound of collapsing earth and shattered ancestral bodies.
Meanwhile, Luke's cultivation technique immediately began gathering the remains of the fallen Orcs.
FWHOOOSH!

Crimson radiance spread across the devastated region as blood and fragments of flesh emerged from the surrounding space, briefly reconstructing the dead before compressing their remains into Blood Essence Pills.
Thousands of crimson lights gathered together, forming streams that rushed toward Luke's main body.
[DING!]
[Eternal Titan Zero — Body Reconstruction Progress]
Luke stared at the numbers, his smile widening as the final percentage appeared.
'Finally, six percent!'
After spending more than a month destroying outposts for relatively little progress, he had finally found an opportunity to accumulate Blood Essence at a satisfying rate.
Unfortunately for the Zhurkhal Tribe, the very formation intended to trap and kill him had now become the reason their warriors were unable to escape his attacks.

The crimson dome continued covering the battlefield, preventing the surviving Orcs from fleeing beyond its boundaries, while the enormous ancestral phantoms they had created made themselves convenient targets for Luke's destructive techniques.

Even the eight Peak B-Rank commanders were struggling to interrupt him, since his two clones continued interfering with their movements while his main body freely shifted between different Titan Authorities.
High above the battlefield, Gorzak slowly lowered his gaze toward the devastated sections of the Orc army.
His earlier excitement had completely disappeared.
"Vradok..."
The Great Shaman remained silent.
"Tell me something."
Gorzak pointed toward Luke's distant figure, which was floating above the ruined battlefield while the two Vorthar clones continued fighting below.
"WHY DOES IT LOOK LIKE WE'RE THE ONES WHO WALKED INTO A TRAP?!"
Kroghar didn't immediately answer.

Across the battlefield, thousands of ancestral phantoms had already been destroyed, while several Peak B-Rank commanders were injured and the hundred remaining B-Rank warriors were struggling to overcome only two clones.
Meanwhile, the Hero responsible for all this destruction continued looking toward the surviving Orc army with obvious interest.
Vradok's expression became increasingly dark.
For the first time, the Great Shaman began feeling that he had seriously underestimated the danger posed by this particular Hero.
However, what disturbed him most was the increasing frequency of those strange crimson pills.
Every time Luke killed more Orcs, the crimson lights gathered toward his body, and the Hero's aura seemed to become slightly more stable afterward.
'He's using our warriors to cultivate...'
Vradok finally understood what was happening.
Unfortunately, that realization came far too late.
Meanwhile, Luke floated above the battlefield, his silver wings spread behind his seventy-foot Vorthar body while the golden-white halo continued rotating.
Below him, the surviving Orcs had begun retreating in different directions, desperately attempting to avoid the area directly beneath his position.
However, the crimson dome remained intact.
Luke slowly raised his head toward the barrier.
Then he looked back toward the army.
A satisfied smile appeared on his face.
'Since they won't let me leave...'
He raised his right hand, causing golden-white Cosmic Energy to gather around his palm while black Void Energy began appearing along its edges.
'...I might as well make the most of this opportunity.'
OHHHHMMMM!
The celestial bodies above him began moving once again.
At the same time, his two clones turned toward the remaining B-Rank commanders, their black and rainbow-colored halos flaring as they prepared another combination of Titan Authorities.
Seeing the familiar signs of another attack, several nearby Orcs immediately began shouting in terror.
"HE'S PREPARING ANOTHER TECHNIQUE!"
"COMMANDERS! STOP HIM!"
"WE CAN'T KEEP FIGHTING THIS MONSTER!"
Unfortunately, Luke merely looked down upon them and said.
"Playtime's over."

Luke's voice echoed across the devastated battlefield, carrying none of the amusement he had shown while hunting the lower-ranked Orcs, as his gaze shifted from the retreating army toward the crimson dome still covering the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 390: “Face the Horror of a Titan.”
paragraphs: The golden-white halo behind his head suddenly accelerated, releasing a brilliant surge of Cosmic Energy that spread through the surrounding air.
OHHHHMMMM!
Before the eight Peak B-Rank commanders could understand what he was preparing, ten golden-white spatial ripples appeared behind his seventy-foot Vorthar body.

One after another, gigantic figures emerged from those distortions, their bodies carrying the unmistakable characteristics of the Cosmic Heart Titan, while dense celestial energy radiated from their forms.
Within moments, ten Cosmic Heart Titan copies stood behind Luke, arranged across the sky beneath the crimson dome.
"W-WHAT?!"
"THERE ARE MORE OF THEM?!"
"HOW MANY GIANTS CAN THIS BASTARD SUMMON?!"

The sudden appearance of ten additional Titans immediately alarmed the surrounding Orcs, with several ancestral phantoms instinctively retreating as their commanders stared toward the growing formation.
Even Gurvak and the other Peak B-Rank commanders hesitated, unable to understand how the Hero could continue producing such extraordinary abilities after fighting for so long.
However, Luke ignored their reactions.

Through his subconscious control, he immediately instructed the ten Cosmic Heart copies to activate their celestial manifestations, allowing him to direct their actions without dividing his already strained concentration any further.
All ten raised their right hands toward the sky.
"Cosmos Manifestation!"
OHHHHHHMMMMMM!
Ten brilliant golden-white lights suddenly erupted above the battlefield, each expanding into a complete Cosmic System containing planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and a radiant sun.

The celestial bodies began moving along their respective orbital paths, filling the space beneath the dome with swirling Cosmic Energy as the ten newly summoned systems took shape around Luke's original manifestation.

For a moment, the entire sky appeared to have transformed into a miniature cosmos, with dozens of celestial bodies moving above the Orc army while their combined radiance illuminated the ruined forest and shattered earth below.
"What... what are those things?"
Several Orcs stared upward in disbelief, watching miniature planets pass beneath the crimson barrier while golden-white comets left brilliant trails across the sky.
However, Luke had no intention of allowing the systems to remain separated.
"HAAAH!"
The ten Cosmic Heart copies exerted their strength simultaneously, extending their hands toward the Cosmic System already floating above Luke's main body.
There, the planets, moons, asteroids, and comets had begun approaching their central sun, their orbital distances shrinking as Luke gradually compressed the entire celestial arrangement.
VMMMMMMMM!
The gravitational influence surrounding the original system intensified, causing its celestial bodies to accelerate inward while the sun at its center grew increasingly brighter.
Then the ten additional Cosmic Systems began moving.
Their individual orbital arrangements distorted as the copies forced them toward Luke's original system, bringing their celestial bodies into contact with the already compressed formation.
RUMMMMMBLE!
The first system collided with the outer celestial arrangement, followed almost immediately by the second and third, while tremendous waves of Cosmic Energy erupted from the points of contact.
However, the colliding systems didn't simply shatter.

Under the continuous control of the ten Cosmic Heart copies, their celestial bodies began merging into the central formation, with planets pressing against planets, moons breaking into condensed streams of matter, and asteroids and comets being drawn toward the increasingly unstable sun.
KRRRRRRUMBLE!
Golden-white energy swept across the sky as the remaining systems joined the compression, their orbital structures collapsing inward under the force exerted by the copies.
The sun at the center began expanding.
Its original golden-white surface gradually deepened into a brilliant orange, then into an intense crimson-red as more celestial matter and energy were compressed into its growing body.
The surrounding space trembled beneath the rising pressure, while waves of heat spread downward across the battlefield, forcing several Orcs to raise their arms against the radiance.
"What are they doing?!"
"THE SUN IS GETTING BIGGER!"
Above them, the celestial bodies continued merging, their individual forms disappearing into the swelling star as the surrounding Cosmic Energy grew increasingly unstable.
Unfortunately, Luke hadn't finished preparing the technique.

At that moment, his rainbow-halo clone finally withdrew the seals restraining the hundred B-Rank Orcs, allowing the exhausted warriors to recover their movements as the clone disappeared through a spatial ripple.
FWHOOOSH!
Both Vorthar clones reappeared beside Luke's main body, standing on either side of him with their seventy-foot frames covered in pitch-black Valzareth Armor.
The two clones immediately raised their heads toward the developing celestial formation.
Then the rainbow-colored halo behind the second clone began changing.
Its four colors gradually faded beneath a spreading darkness, until both clones possessed rotating pitch-black halos radiating dense Void Energy.
VMMMMMMMM!

With their free right hands extended toward the sky, both clones began concentrating their Void power around the merging Cosmic Systems, reinforcing the compression already being performed by the ten Cosmic Heart copies.
"MERGE!"
Their voices echoed simultaneously.
OHHHHHHHHMMMMMM!
The black halos flared, and the space surrounding the celestial formation suddenly contracted under the additional pressure.

The remaining planets and moons were dragged inward, while the scattered asteroids and comets accelerated toward the central star, their surfaces disintegrating as they entered the increasingly violent gravitational field.
RUMMMMMBLE!
The crimson sun expanded again, swallowing the final celestial bodies as the immense quantity of Cosmic Energy gathered within it continued increasing.

Its surface began churning with violent streams of red and golden-white light, while enormous waves of stellar energy rolled across its outer layers before being forced back into the compressed structure.
The surrounding atmosphere distorted beneath the heat.

Even from the ground, the Orcs could feel the oppressive radiance spreading over their bodies, while the earth beneath several nearby ancestral phantoms began cracking as the gravitational pressure increased.
Within moments, the individual Cosmic Systems had almost completely disappeared, leaving behind a single gigantic crimson star suspended beneath the dome.

The star had already grown far beyond the size of Luke's original sun, while its brilliance spread across the entire battlefield, bathing the ruined outpost and surrounding forest in a deep crimson light.
For several seconds, the Orc commanders could only stare at the terrifying celestial body.
Then Uzgor finally understood what Luke was preparing.
"WHAT THE HELL IS THAT?!"
His voice carried genuine alarm as he sensed the extraordinary amount of energy contained within the compressed star.
Even the eight Peak B-Rank commanders could feel that the power gathering overhead had already surpassed the attacks they had witnessed earlier.
If that unstable celestial body were allowed to descend and explode inside the dome, the resulting destruction could easily consume the entire battlefield.
Brukha immediately turned toward the other commanders.
"STOP HIM! IF THAT THING EXPLODES, NONE OF US WILL SURVIVE!"
Gurvak's expression changed as well, his earlier anger replaced by alarm upon realizing that Luke was preparing an attack dangerous enough to threaten himself.
"IS THAT BASTARD TRYING TO KILL HIMSELF ALONG WITH US?!
However, none of them had time to consider his intentions.
"EVERYONE, ATTACK THE HERO!"
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
The eight Peak B-Rank commanders kicked against the ground almost simultaneously, launching their two-hundred-foot ancestral phantoms toward the sky as their auras erupted with renewed intensity.
Brakka raised her battleaxes, Uzgor concentrated crimson energy around his spear, and the remaining commanders gathered their strongest techniques while rushing toward the three Vorthar bodies.
Unfortunately, Luke had already anticipated their interference.
Both of his clones lowered their free left hands toward the approaching commanders.
"Void Horizon!"
OHHHHMMMM!
The pitch-black halos behind their heads erupted with dense Void Energy, and two spatial distortions immediately spread across the paths of the incoming Orcs.
The distance between the commanders and Luke suddenly stretched, causing their enormous ancestral phantoms to slow despite the tremendous force propelling them forward.
"What?!"
"NOT THAT DAMNED TECHNIQUE AGAIN!"
Gurvak roared in frustration and increased his strength, driving his enormous body through the distorted space as the other commanders attempted to do the same.
Unfortunately, every moment they spent struggling against Void Horizon gave Luke more time to complete his attack.
Meanwhile, the crimson star continued expanding above him, its unstable surface now releasing waves of heat that made the entire atmosphere beneath the dome tremble.
Luke slowly raised his head toward the terrifying celestial formation.
Then he looked down at the Orc commanders struggling to reach him.
A faint smile appeared on his face.
"Face the horror of a Titan."
RUMMMMMMMMMBLE!
The instant those words escaped his mouth, an extraordinary concentration of Force suddenly erupted behind his seventy-foot body.
The surrounding air trembled as a gigantic spectral figure began emerging from the gathering energy, its enormous frame gradually rising toward the crimson sky.
At first, only the outline of its upper body could be distinguished through the swirling Force.
However, as more energy gathered, the phantom became increasingly clear, revealing the muscular physique and imposing features of Azrion, the Atlas Titan.

The manifestation continued expanding until its gigantic head nearly touched the uppermost section of the ancestral dome, while its shoulders stretched across an extraordinary distance above the battlefield.
OHHHHMMMM!
Its eyes opened.
For an instant, the eight Peak B-Rank commanders felt an inexplicable pressure descend upon them as the spectral Atlas Titan lowered its gaze.

The figure regarded the enormous ancestral Orc phantoms beneath it with complete indifference, as though the two-hundred-foot warriors struggling toward Luke were no different from insignificant insects.
"What... is that?"
Brakka's voice trembled slightly as she stared at the gigantic manifestation towering above them.
Even Gurvak momentarily forgot about forcing his way through Void Horizon, his attention drawn toward the colossal figure whose body nearly reached the ceiling of their ancestral formation.
Unfortunately, the appearance of Azrion's phantom was merely the beginning.
Luke slowly raised his right hand.
"Azrion's Unwritten Arts"

sentences.text: The golden-white halo behind his head suddenly accelerated, releasing a brilliant surge of Cosmic Energy that spread through the surrounding air.
OHHHHMMMM!
Before the eight Peak B-Rank commanders could understand what he was preparing, ten golden-white spatial ripples appeared behind his seventy-foot Vorthar body.

One after another, gigantic figures emerged from those distortions, their bodies carrying the unmistakable characteristics of the Cosmic Heart Titan, while dense celestial energy radiated from their forms.
Within moments, ten Cosmic Heart Titan copies stood behind Luke, arranged across the sky beneath the crimson dome.
"W-WHAT?!"
"THERE ARE MORE OF THEM?!"
"HOW MANY GIANTS CAN THIS BASTARD SUMMON?!"

The sudden appearance of ten additional Titans immediately alarmed the surrounding Orcs, with several ancestral phantoms instinctively retreating as their commanders stared toward the growing formation.
Even Gurvak and the other Peak B-Rank commanders hesitated, unable to understand how the Hero could continue producing such extraordinary abilities after fighting for so long.
However, Luke ignored their reactions.

Through his subconscious control, he immediately instructed the ten Cosmic Heart copies to activate their celestial manifestations, allowing him to direct their actions without dividing his already strained concentration any further.
All ten raised their right hands toward the sky.
"Cosmos Manifestation!"
OHHHHHHMMMMMM!
Ten brilliant golden-white lights suddenly erupted above the battlefield, each expanding into a complete Cosmic System containing planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and a radiant sun.

The celestial bodies began moving along their respective orbital paths, filling the space beneath the dome with swirling Cosmic Energy as the ten newly summoned systems took shape around Luke's original manifestation.

For a moment, the entire sky appeared to have transformed into a miniature cosmos, with dozens of celestial bodies moving above the Orc army while their combined radiance illuminated the ruined forest and shattered earth below.
"What... what are those things?"
Several Orcs stared upward in disbelief, watching miniature planets pass beneath the crimson barrier while golden-white comets left brilliant trails across the sky.
However, Luke had no intention of allowing the systems to remain separated.
"HAAAH!"
The ten Cosmic Heart copies exerted their strength simultaneously, extending their hands toward the Cosmic System already floating above Luke's main body.
There, the planets, moons, asteroids, and comets had begun approaching their central sun, their orbital distances shrinking as Luke gradually compressed the entire celestial arrangement.
VMMMMMMMM!
The gravitational influence surrounding the original system intensified, causing its celestial bodies to accelerate inward while the sun at its center grew increasingly brighter.
Then the ten additional Cosmic Systems began moving.
Their individual orbital arrangements distorted as the copies forced them toward Luke's original system, bringing their celestial bodies into contact with the already compressed formation.
RUMMMMMBLE!
The first system collided with the outer celestial arrangement, followed almost immediately by the second and third, while tremendous waves of Cosmic Energy erupted from the points of contact.
However, the colliding systems didn't simply shatter.

Under the continuous control of the ten Cosmic Heart copies, their celestial bodies began merging into the central formation, with planets pressing against planets, moons breaking into condensed streams of matter, and asteroids and comets being drawn toward the increasingly unstable sun.
KRRRRRRUMBLE!
Golden-white energy swept across the sky as the remaining systems joined the compression, their orbital structures collapsing inward under the force exerted by the copies.
The sun at the center began expanding.
Its original golden-white surface gradually deepened into a brilliant orange, then into an intense crimson-red as more celestial matter and energy were compressed into its growing body.
The surrounding space trembled beneath the rising pressure, while waves of heat spread downward across the battlefield, forcing several Orcs to raise their arms against the radiance.
"What are they doing?!"
"THE SUN IS GETTING BIGGER!"
Above them, the celestial bodies continued merging, their individual forms disappearing into the swelling star as the surrounding Cosmic Energy grew increasingly unstable.
Unfortunately, Luke hadn't finished preparing the technique.

At that moment, his rainbow-halo clone finally withdrew the seals restraining the hundred B-Rank Orcs, allowing the exhausted warriors to recover their movements as the clone disappeared through a spatial ripple.
FWHOOOSH!
Both Vorthar clones reappeared beside Luke's main body, standing on either side of him with their seventy-foot frames covered in pitch-black Valzareth Armor.
The two clones immediately raised their heads toward the developing celestial formation.
Then the rainbow-colored halo behind the second clone began changing.
Its four colors gradually faded beneath a spreading darkness, until both clones possessed rotating pitch-black halos radiating dense Void Energy.
VMMMMMMMM!

With their free right hands extended toward the sky, both clones began concentrating their Void power around the merging Cosmic Systems, reinforcing the compression already being performed by the ten Cosmic Heart copies.
"MERGE!"
Their voices echoed simultaneously.
OHHHHHHHHMMMMMM!
The black halos flared, and the space surrounding the celestial formation suddenly contracted under the additional pressure.

The remaining planets and moons were dragged inward, while the scattered asteroids and comets accelerated toward the central star, their surfaces disintegrating as they entered the increasingly violent gravitational field.
RUMMMMMBLE!
The crimson sun expanded again, swallowing the final celestial bodies as the immense quantity of Cosmic Energy gathered within it continued increasing.

Its surface began churning with violent streams of red and golden-white light, while enormous waves of stellar energy rolled across its outer layers before being forced back into the compressed structure.
The surrounding atmosphere distorted beneath the heat.

Even from the ground, the Orcs could feel the oppressive radiance spreading over their bodies, while the earth beneath several nearby ancestral phantoms began cracking as the gravitational pressure increased.
Within moments, the individual Cosmic Systems had almost completely disappeared, leaving behind a single gigantic crimson star suspended beneath the dome.

The star had already grown far beyond the size of Luke's original sun, while its brilliance spread across the entire battlefield, bathing the ruined outpost and surrounding forest in a deep crimson light.
For several seconds, the Orc commanders could only stare at the terrifying celestial body.
Then Uzgor finally understood what Luke was preparing.
"WHAT THE HELL IS THAT?!"
His voice carried genuine alarm as he sensed the extraordinary amount of energy contained within the compressed star.
Even the eight Peak B-Rank commanders could feel that the power gathering overhead had already surpassed the attacks they had witnessed earlier.
If that unstable celestial body were allowed to descend and explode inside the dome, the resulting destruction could easily consume the entire battlefield.
Brukha immediately turned toward the other commanders.
"STOP HIM!
IF THAT THING EXPLODES, NONE OF US WILL SURVIVE!"
Gurvak's expression changed as well, his earlier anger replaced by alarm upon realizing that Luke was preparing an attack dangerous enough to threaten himself.
"IS THAT BASTARD TRYING TO KILL HIMSELF ALONG WITH US?!
However, none of them had time to consider his intentions.
"EVERYONE, ATTACK THE HERO!"
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM!
The eight Peak B-Rank commanders kicked against the ground almost simultaneously, launching their two-hundred-foot ancestral phantoms toward the sky as their auras erupted with renewed intensity.
Brakka raised her battleaxes, Uzgor concentrated crimson energy around his spear, and the remaining commanders gathered their strongest techniques while rushing toward the three Vorthar bodies.
Unfortunately, Luke had already anticipated their interference.
Both of his clones lowered their free left hands toward the approaching commanders.
"Void Horizon!"

Luke slowly raised his right hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 391: “FACE THE WRATH OF HEAVEN!”
paragraphs: OHHHHHHMMMMMM!
The spectral Titan responded, lifting its enormous arm as an extraordinary quantity of Force gathered around its open palm.

Within moments, a three-kilometer-wide hand began materializing beneath the gigantic phantom, its five spectral fingers spreading across the sky while the surrounding atmosphere distorted beneath the physical pressure radiating from its surface.
The manifestation continued gathering Force, becoming increasingly dense as Luke poured more energy into it through his main body and both Vorthar clones.
At the same time, the Cosmic Heart assimilated within his body continued beating, pumping additional energy through his Titan physique to sustain the terrifying technique.
THUMP! THUMP!
Each pulse sent another surge of power into the spectral palm, while the ten Cosmic Heart copies maintained their control over the crimson star suspended above the battlefield.
Luke's muscles tightened beneath Valzareth as he prepared to release the attack, feeling the enormous burden of controlling so much Force through his current D-Rank body.
However, he had no intention of stopping.
"First Move: Heaven's Palm"
VMMMMMMMM!
The three-kilometer hand began descending.
To the Orcs watching from below, its movement initially appeared strangely slow, as though the gigantic palm were gradually lowering itself through the sky.

However, the illusion came from its extraordinary size, since the spectral construct was already moving with terrifying speed, carrying the accumulated Force supplied by Luke's main body, both clones, and the Cosmic Heart.
The immense pressure beneath it caused the air to compress, while violent winds spread across the ruined battlefield as the palm approached the gigantic crimson star.
At that moment, Luke finally shouted.
"FACE THE WRATH OF HEAVEN!"
His right arm moved downward, and the enormous phantom of Azrion responded by driving its hand toward the compressed celestial formation.
"STARFALL!!!"
THAAAAAAM!
Heaven's Palm struck the upper surface of the gigantic crimson sun.
For an instant, the star's outer layers distorted beneath the impact, sending violent waves of red and golden-white energy spreading across its surface.
Then the entire celestial body lurched downward.
RUMMMMMMMMMBLE!
The three-kilometer palm continued pressing against the star, forcing the already compressed celestial energy toward the battlefield with rapidly increasing momentum.

Its surface became increasingly unstable, with brilliant fissures of golden-white light spreading through the surrounding crimson radiance as the enormous quantity of energy within it struggled to remain contained.
The surrounding atmosphere immediately began heating.
Across the battlefield, loose stones trembled and fractured beneath the descending pressure, while the remaining trees bent violently as waves of burning wind swept through their branches.
KRRRRAAAACK! FWHOOOOOSH!
The enormous ancestral phantoms standing beneath the falling star began staggering, their crimson bodies trembling as the pressure descended upon them.
Several tried to retreat, but the crowded formations made it difficult to escape, especially with the ancestral dome restricting the surrounding region.
"WHAT IS THAT?!"
"THE SUN IS FALLING!"
"WE'RE GOING TO DIE!!!"
Terrified shouts erupted throughout the Orc army as the warriors finally understood what Luke had unleashed.
Even the eight Peak B-Rank commanders stopped trying to reach him.
They could sense that the descending attack had already surpassed their combined strength, and continuing their charge would only place them directly beneath the concentrated celestial energy.
"EVERYONE, DEFEND YOURSELVES!" Brukha screamed, desperately gathering ancestral energy around her two-hundred-foot phantom.
Gurvak immediately crossed his enormous arms, while Brakka raised both battleaxes above her head and Uzgor drove his spear into the ground, attempting to stabilize his defensive position.
Drukon hurriedly began chanting protective incantations, his staff releasing crimson markings that spread toward the nearby commanders as they gathered their remaining strength.
OHHHHMMMM!
Defensive barriers erupted across the battlefield.

Thousands of ancestral phantoms began channeling their energy into protective techniques, while the lower-ranked Orcs desperately reinforced their formations in an attempt to survive the incoming catastrophe.
Unfortunately, the pressure continued increasing as Heaven's Palm drove the crimson star toward the center of the dome.
The heat was now so intense that the surrounding air appeared to twist, while the red light illuminating the battlefield gradually became brighter.
Some Orcs simply dropped their weapons and stared upward, their faces filled with despair as they watched the gigantic celestial body descend toward them.
"NO! I DON'T WANT TO DIE!"
"COMMANDER, SAVE US!"
"PLEASE! STOP THAT THING!"
Their desperate voices mixed with the continuous rumbling of the approaching star, although Luke showed no intention of withdrawing the attack.
After all, he had already committed the combined power of his Cosmic Systems and Azrion's Unwritten Arts to this final strike.
And now, even he couldn't afford to interrupt it carelessly.
Outside the crimson dome, Gorzak, Kroghar, and Vradok were staring at the descending celestial body with expressions of complete disbelief.

They had sensed the extraordinary amount of power gathering earlier, but the moment Heaven's Palm struck the compressed star and forced it downward, the true danger of the attack finally became apparent.
"THIS...!"
Gorzak's voice faltered as he examined the terrifying pressure radiating from the celestial formation.
"HOW CAN A D-RANK HERO RELEASE SOMETHING LIKE THAT?!"
Kroghar remained silent, his expression becoming increasingly grave as he watched the crimson star approach the ground.

The energy contained within the attack had already reached the level of a half A-Rank existence, and if the compressed celestial body were to release its power completely, the resulting destruction could potentially reduce a region stretching hundreds of kilometers to ruins.
More importantly, the ancestral dome was currently containing that terrifying energy within its boundaries.
If the formation failed under the impact, the consequences would be disastrous.
Vradok finally understood why Luke had gathered so many Cosmic Systems before unleashing Heaven's Palm.
'This madman...!'
For the first time, genuine alarm appeared on the Great Shaman's face.
'He's actually prepared an attack that could kill him along with everyone inside!'
The realization caused Vradok to immediately turn his attention toward the ancestral formation, whose crimson markings had already begun reacting to the pressure gathering within its boundaries.
"Gorzak! Kroghar! Prepare yourselves!"

Hearing his urgent warning, both A-Rank Orcs immediately gathered their energy, understanding that the Great Shaman wouldn't have spoken with such alarm unless the situation had become extremely dangerous.
Meanwhile, Emberlyn was watching the same terrifying sight from her concealed position among the trees.
The moment she sensed the power gathering within the compressed celestial star, her expression changed completely.
'Luke! What are you doing?!'
She had already witnessed his extraordinary abilities throughout their journey, but the attack he was preparing had reached a level that even she couldn't casually withstand.
Worse still, he was releasing it inside a sealed region containing himself.
'Is he seriously planning to destroy the entire formation with everyone inside?!'
Emberlyn immediately began channeling her energy, surrounding herself with protective power as she prepared to withstand the approaching destruction.
OHHHHMMMM!
A dense defensive barrier formed around her hidden position, its surface shimmering faintly as she continued reinforcing it.
However, her worried gaze remained fixed upon Luke's distant figure.
'You'd better survive this, Luke...'
Above the battlefield, the gigantic crimson star was already approaching the ground.
RUMMMMMMMMMBLE!

The descending celestial body illuminated the entire region with an increasingly intense crimson radiance, while Heaven's Palm continued pressing against its upper surface, driving it downward with all the accumulated Force of the Atlas Titan.
The ground beneath the targeted region began sinking even before the attack arrived, while enormous cracks spread outward through the shattered earth as the gravitational pressure increased.
KRRRRRRAAAAAACK!
The ancestral phantoms standing near the center struggled to maintain their defensive formations, their enormous bodies trembling as crimson energy erupted from their tattoos.
"EVERYONE, HOLD THE DEFENSE!"
"POUR EVERYTHING INTO THE FORMATION!"
Several Peak B-Rank commanders roared their orders, desperately reinforcing their protective barriers while the lower-ranked Orcs followed with whatever strength they could gather.
Unfortunately, their defenses were already beginning to strain beneath the approaching celestial energy.
Golden-white cracks appeared across several protective barriers, while others trembled violently as the pressure descended upon them.
The gigantic crimson sun continued falling.
Its burning surface was now close enough to illuminate every crack in the ruined ground, while the shadow of Heaven's Palm stretched across the upper portion of the dome.
For an instant, the entire battlefield seemed to fall into a strange silence beneath the overwhelming pressure.
Then the compressed star reached the ground.
THAAAAAAM!
The first contact occurred at the center of the battlefield, where the burning celestial surface touched the fractured earth.
And at that exact instant, the compressed energy within the star erupted.
FWHAAAAAAAAAASH!

An extraordinary flash of golden-white light burst outward, spreading across the interior of the crimson dome with such speed that the surrounding battlefield disappeared beneath its brilliance before anyone could properly react.
The gigantic star released the combined energy of the eleven Cosmic Systems, while Heaven's Palm continued pressing downward, forcing that destructive power into the ground.

For a fraction of a second, the entire region beneath the dome became brighter than daylight, its forests, shattered buildings, ancestral phantoms, and countless Orc warriors vanishing within the expanding radiance.
Even the crimson barrier itself was illuminated from within, its dark red surface suddenly appearing almost white as the destructive energy pressed against every section of the formation.
Then came the sound.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
A horrifying explosion erupted from the center of the battlefield, releasing a thunderous sound that spread far beyond the sealed region and echoed throughout Bravaryn.
RUMMMMMMMMMBLE!
The earth trembled beneath the impact, while the surrounding atmosphere shook as waves of destructive force continued expanding from the point where the celestial star had struck.
High above the battlefield, the three A-Rank Orcs instinctively raised their arms against the blinding radiance.
However, even through the overwhelming light, they could see the crimson dome beginning to change.
The ancient markings circulating across its surface suddenly accelerated, flashing violently as the ancestral formation struggled to contain the energy erupting within.
VMMMMMMMM!
Then a thin crack appeared along its upper section.
KRRRKKK!
Vradok's expression changed immediately.
'Impossible!'
Before he could react, the crack spread.
KRRRRRAAAAAACK!
More fractures appeared across the crimson surface, branching outward in different directions as the internal pressure continued increasing.
Within moments, the entire dome was covered in glowing cracks, its ancient markings flickering erratically as the formation's structure began failing.
"THE FORMATION!" Gorzak shouted, staring at the spreading fractures with horror.
Unfortunately, his warning came too late.
KRRRRRRAAAAAAAAAASH!!!
The crimson dome finally shattered.
Its gigantic curved surface broke apart into innumerable fragments of red light, which scattered across the sky before being swallowed by the brilliant energy erupting from the battlefield below.
OHHHHHHHHMMMMMMMM!
The moment the barrier disappeared, the light contained within it surged outward, expanding beyond the former boundaries of the formation as the remaining destructive energy continued spreading.
Gorzak, Kroghar, and Vradok stared toward the region where their army had been gathered only moments earlier.

However, the intense golden-white radiance had completely swallowed everything beneath them, making it impossible to distinguish the battlefield, the surviving Orcs, or even the Hero responsible for the catastrophe.
The three A-Rank leaders could only watch as the blinding light continued expanding across the region, while the thunderous rumble of the explosion echoed through Bravaryn.
And within that brilliance, no one could tell what had happened to Luke or the millions of Orcs trapped inside the formation.

KRRRKKK!
Vradok's expression changed immediately.
'Impossible!'
Before he could react, the crack spread.
KRRRRRAAAAAACK!
More fractures appeared across the crimson surface, branching outward in different directions as the internal pressure continued increasing.
Within moments, the entire dome was covered in glowing cracks, its ancient markings flickering erratically as the formation's structure began failing.
"THE FORMATION!" Gorzak shouted, staring at the spreading fractures with horror.
Unfortunately, his warning came too late.
KRRRRRRAAAAAAAAAASH!!!
The crimson dome finally shattered.
Its gigantic curved surface broke apart into innumerable fragments of red light, which scattered across the sky before being swallowed by the brilliant energy erupting from the battlefield below.
OHHHHHHHHMMMMMMMM!
The moment the barrier disappeared, the light contained within it surged outward, expanding beyond the former boundaries of the formation as the remaining destructive energy continued spreading.
Gorzak, Kroghar, and Vradok stared toward the region where their army had been gathered only moments earlier.

However, the intense golden-white radiance had completely swallowed everything beneath them, making it impossible to distinguish the battlefield, the surviving Orcs, or even the Hero responsible for the catastrophe.
The three A-Rank leaders could only watch as the blinding light continued expanding across the region, while the thunderous rumble of the explosion echoed through Bravaryn.
And within that brilliance, no one could tell what had happened to Luke or the millions of Orcs trapped inside the formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 392: Eternal Titan Zero — 50.00%!
paragraphs: After the blinding radiance disappeared, a deadly silence settled across the hundreds of kilometers devastated by Luke's final attack.

The forests that had once covered the region were almost completely gone, leaving behind shattered mountainsides, deep craters, and stretches of blackened earth, while fires continued burning among the surviving trees, threatening to spread for days unless a powerful existence intervened.

Even the ordinary sounds of nature had disappeared, since nearly every living creature caught within the explosion, from insects and birds to the millions of Orcs gathered beneath the ancestral dome, had perished.
Only the three A-Rank Orc leaders remained concealed above the devastation, silently observing the ruined battlefield while waiting to see whether anything had survived.
Then, amid that silence, a violent cough suddenly echoed.
"COUGH! COUGH!"
The coughing continued, accompanied by a painful groan that sounded as though its owner was struggling to remain alive.
"Ughhh! Even Vorthar can feel this much pain?"
A weak voice followed, its owner apparently attempting to joke despite the terrible condition of his body.
Inside one of the craters lay Luke's seventy-foot Vorthar form, covered in blood and terrible injuries, with golden-red liquid continuing to flow from the wounds scattered across his damaged torso.
Anyone familiar with Luke would have been astonished by the unusual color of his blood, which appeared golden with traces of crimson, although his current physical condition was even more shocking.

Both of his arms and legs had disappeared, leaving him with little more than his upper body, while portions of his remaining flesh were torn open and burned from the destructive force of his own attack.
"Huff... Hahh..."
Luke struggled to breathe, his enormous chest rising and falling unevenly as he tried to endure the pain spreading throughout his body.
'Damn it...'
He wanted to move, but the moment he attempted to shift his shoulders, a sharp pain traveled through his damaged torso, immediately forcing him to stop.
'This hurts more than I expected.'

Even with Vorthar's extraordinary physique, the injuries were severe enough to overwhelm most beings, and Luke understood that he was only maintaining his Titan transformation through sheer willpower.
Fortunately, the enormous Titan body could still endure injuries that would have been fatal to his ordinary humanoid form.
'At least I didn't die.'
He attempted another breath, only to cough violently.
"COUGH!"
Golden-red blood spilled from his mouth, flowing down his chin before dripping onto the scorched earth.
However, as Luke glanced toward the System screen floating at the corner of his vision, his pained expression gradually changed.
A familiar number was displayed there.
For a moment, he simply stared at the notification.
Then his bloodied lips curled into a smile.
"Hahaha—COUGH! COUGH!"
"Damn it! Can't I even laugh properly?!"
Luke immediately stopped laughing as another coughing fit shook his body, although he couldn't hide his satisfaction upon seeing the result of the battle.
'Fifty percent!'

After spending more than a month hunting Orcs and destroying their outposts, he had struggled to accumulate even a small portion of the Blood Essence required for his Eternal Titan Zero reconstruction.
Yet the destruction of the Zhurkhal army had brought his progress all the way to fifty percent.
'Halfway to C-Rank...'
If his body hadn't been in such a terrible condition, Luke would probably have celebrated immediately.
Unfortunately, merely remaining conscious was already proving difficult.
'Hah... I almost killed myself for that.
He lowered his gaze toward the places where his arms and legs should have been, noticing that golden-red blood was still escaping from the exposed wounds.
His physical and mental strength had been almost completely exhausted during the final attack, while the Cosmic Heart he had assimilated earlier had already reverted to normal.
Even the remaining energy within his body was barely sufficient to sustain his Vorthar transformation.
'First, I need to stop this bleeding.'
Luke attempted to gather enough energy to activate the Seal of Closure, but the moment he tried concentrating, an intense headache made his vision blur.
"Ughhh..."
He immediately abandoned the attempt.
Fortunately, someone else could help him.
"Kiki... come out."
VMMMM!
A faint crimson glow appeared above Luke's chest, gradually condensing into a small coffin approximately one foot tall.
Compared to its previous twenty-five-foot form, Kiki looked rather insignificant, although summoning even this much had already consumed a considerable portion of Luke's remaining energy.
"Kiki?"
The little coffin tilted its body, seemingly confused by the terrible condition of its master.
"Yeah, buddy... see these wounds?"
Luke glanced toward his missing arm before looking back at Kiki.
"Close them for me. I can't keep bleeding like—COUGH! COUGH!"
Another mouthful of golden blood escaped his lips, interrupting his words.
"Kiki!"
Understanding the command, Kiki immediately extended its small spider-like legs and began climbing across Luke's enormous body.
Upon reaching the exposed wound near his shoulder, it released thin golden-white silk threads that spread across the damaged flesh.
FSSSH! FSSSH!
The threads quickly began weaving together, covering the open wound before tightening and sealing its surface.
Kiki continued moving across his body, carefully closing the injuries one after another, including the places where his limbs had been destroyed.
Although the ability couldn't restore his missing arms and legs, it prevented further blood loss and gave his damaged body an opportunity to recover.
"Hahhh..."
Luke released a relieved sigh as the bleeding gradually slowed.
"Good job, buddy."
"Kiki!"
The little coffin responded cheerfully before continuing its work, while Luke raised his head toward the smoke-covered sky.
'Now... how am I supposed to restore these limbs?'
His thoughts naturally drifted toward the Epitaph Titan's Final Record, which possessed the extraordinary ability to restore destroyed existences from their recorded states.
'Final Record might help.'
If he could use it to restore his missing limbs, he wouldn't have to depend entirely upon his Titan body's natural restorative properties.
Unfortunately, the ability required considerable concentration and energy, both of which he currently lacked.
'I'll deal with that after recovering some strength.'
He closed his eyes for a moment, hoping to ease the headache pounding through his consciousness.
However, the instant he relaxed, an overwhelming wave of exhaustion nearly caused him to faint.
'Shit!'
Luke immediately forced himself to remain awake.
His mental energy had fallen so low that he could barely maintain his thoughts, and he finally understood why none of his Titan spirits had appeared after the explosion.
Their manifestations outside his body also consumed mental strength, so with his remaining reserves almost completely depleted, all four spirits had withdrawn to rest within him.
Luke sighed, then remembered something important.
'That's right. Emberlyn was inside the dome too.'
'I have to find her.'
Luke attempted to look beyond the crater, but the thick smoke and dust covering the region made it difficult to distinguish anything.
"I have to find Emberl—"
"Well, well, the puppet of the traitor god is still alive."
A rough, mocking voice suddenly interrupted him, causing Luke to turn his head toward the sky.
'Who?!'
He hadn't sensed anyone approaching, although considering his current condition, that wasn't particularly surprising.
With almost ninety percent of his body injured and barely one percent of his strength remaining, even detecting nearby energy fluctuations was becoming difficult.
FWHOOOSH!
Three figures slowly descended through the smoke, their powerful auras making the surrounding air feel heavy despite being deliberately restrained.
Each Orc stood approximately fifteen feet tall, possessing an intimidating physique that immediately distinguished them from the ordinary warriors Luke had fought earlier.
Luke became alarmed as he watched the three approach.
'How the hell did they survive that explosion?!'
However, when he managed to sense a faint portion of their strength, his expression changed completely.
'Wait...'
The pressure radiating from them was far beyond anything he had experienced from the Peak B-Rank commanders.
Luke felt his throat tighten.
'They're A-Rank!'
GULP!
He swallowed the blood gathering inside his mouth, while the three Orcs continued descending toward his crippled body.
Their expressions were filled with hatred, making it obvious that they wanted nothing more than to tear him apart.
Two minutes earlier...
High above the devastated battlefield, Gorzak, Kroghar, and Vradok stared down at the destruction that had claimed almost ninety percent of the Zhurkhal Tribe.
Their eyes were bloodshot with fury, since the army they had gathered to capture a single D-Rank Hero had been nearly annihilated by that same Hero.
Worse still, they believed that Luke had probably perished in the explosion, meaning they had also lost the valuable reward they intended to obtain by capturing him.
"This..."
Gorzak opened his mouth, but for once, the bald Orc Chieftain couldn't find the words to express his anger.
He stared toward the ruined territory, his fists trembling as the veins along his muscular arms bulged beneath his skin.
"That damned bastard destroyed our entire army!"
His furious voice echoed through the air, although Kroghar remained silent beside him, examining the devastation with an equally unpleasant expression.

"Calm down, Gorzak, and think carefully," Vradok finally said, his own crimson eyes filled with anger. "The Hero didn't appear suicidal during the battle, so there's a possibility he prepared some method of surviving that attack."
Gorzak immediately turned toward him.
And Even Kroghar nodded.
"The Great Shaman has a point. He was deliberately gathering power for that attack, and someone with so many strange techniques might have prepared a way to endure the consequences."
